positive: The food is always amazing! You can’t go wrong with Russo’s!!!
The service and the food were outstanding! My husband had the skirt steak and I had the pork milanese. Would return again!
Went for Thanksgiving and had the preset menu. Food ambience and service was excellent. I will definitely be back.
I always do have a great experience at this restaurant.  Very nice ambience and the staff are quiet courteous.

Had a wonderful time at Vetro for our anniversary!  The food was delicious and the service was outstanding, including our waiter Mario and the entire staff from the bartenders to the hostess. Will be back again soon!

First time dining at Vetro. We were a party of six and had a great time. Food was good and the service was excellent. A lot of birthdays in the house so it’s definitely a place for celebratory dinners. Great lounge after dinner with DJ that plays all the old school club tunes. Will be back.
Had a great time at Vetros everyone was great even Alexa the person at the front who walked us to our table. Thanks for an amazing experience.

I do not have anything negative to say about this place. From the entrance we were very welcome. The service was outstanding from the beginning to the end. The menu had so many different options that make it difficult to decide what to eat. I highly recommend this place if you want to be treated with respect and enjoy the environment and delicious food. Thank you to all the staff.
Friendly, profession and courteous staff. Everyone made a very special birthday celebration enjoyable. Service was excellent and the food was very good.
Beautiful restaurant with wonderful and pleasant staff. The birthday girl felt special on her day. Menu could be expanded just a bit but a nice drink selection. Would definitely visit again.

Lovely service. Lovely food. Lovely people. Thank you!!

We’ve been once before and everything was good. This time it was the complete opposite. The Caesar salad was turning and ice cold (must have been from the previous day). The Mac n cheese was buttered noodles and the entrées all needed more seasoning. The evening highlights were the bread and the shrimp pizza for the table.
Live jazz on Sunday made the experience enjoyable and relaxing. The staff was attentive and made good recommendations on menu items. Ricardo and Iris were very welcoming for my first visit.
As usual Mario is a great waiter and the food and drinks were excellent.  Can’t wait return.  What a happy birthday meal
Great place, good service. Solid experience . Highly recommend
Always excellent! Service, food and atmosphere!! Romantic a plus!

In a delightful culinary experience, the restaurant impresses with its exceptional food and cocktails that truly stand out. The service is commendable, striking a perfect balance between attentiveness and discretion, ensuring guests feel both cared for and at ease. For those seeking a romantic evening, the outdoor terrace offers an enchanting ambiance, making it an ideal setting for a memorable date night.

My family has done many party’s at Russo’s.  My fiancé and I are set to get married 10-10-26 at Russo’s. We decided to have a date night and eat at Vetro. The food, The service was outstanding!! Delicious! We agreed to come have date night here once a month. Thank you for everything!!
Beautiful new menu!! Food was excellent! Service top notch!! Such a romantic atmosphere!!

I love coming here. Every time I dine here I am never disappointed. It was date night with my boyfriend and it was amazing. The food was delicious and the atmosphere was romantic. One of my favorite places to have a culinary experience.
Impecable service as always! Food was outstanding.
The food and service was exceptional. We love coming here and highly recommend it.
We had Delicious food and wonderful  service as always

We've eaten at Vetro many times before and the food is consistently good, the decor elegant, the ambiance lovely and the service excellent but this time we had a server by the name of Puro who was just beyond all expectations!  We couldn't have asked for a more professional, delightful or personable server!  If you are lucky enough to have Puro as your server, your experience will be elevated and you will leave feeling like you've just dined at one of the finest restaurants you can imagine!

If you are looking for a great dining experience, make a reservation at Vetro.  You will never be disappointed with the food or the service.  We had a wonderful experience, as always.  Brought a friend for the first time and they loved it.  Make a reservation and enjoy.
Great server named Pure. Food was delicious. In all honesty, I thought it was kind of expensive.

It is always a pleasure to dine at Vetro. Whether we are there as a couple or with family and friends, we are never disappointed! The selection of food and wine provides something for everyone. Our servers are attentive and make sure that our Vetro experience assures that we will keep coming back.
Our waiter Mario was excellent. Very attentive and always a pleasure.
Vetro is esthetically beautiful. The outside patio is serene. Food and service is always consistent.
Mario R was our waiter, he was attentive to us the whole time, the timing between courses was perfect. Highly recommended
Our favorite restaurant in the neighborhood . Great for special occasions and everyday dining. We always feel very special when we dine here. Great food and service!
Food was delicious !   Service was attentive but not annoying and music was soft and lovely dinner music.
It exceeded my expectations!! Everything from the service to the food and ambience was outstanding.    I would definitely recommend and go back.

The service at Russo’s was OUTSTANDING. The service is one of the best I have seen of any restaurant in the Queens/Brooklyn area. The waiter, hostess, and even the manager, all came to my table multiple times to check to see how my experience was, which was a very nice touch.
The waiter knew the menu so well, he could have been the chef cooking our dinner. Very impressive.
I will definitely return to Russo’s and highly recommend this restaurant for anyone looking for an elegant upscale dining experience in Queens.
As always food and service was excellent.   We enjoyed the evening.
Excellent meal with excellent service and attention to detail.
It was a beautiful morning brunch. Service was excellent and polite. We will return.
Another wonderful visit; food, service, and ambiance!
Great service, delicious food and excellent service
Jamie was a great waitress, she come across as friendly and professional. She kept checking on us that we had everything we needed. The cowboy ribeye steak was excellent. Perfect.
Wonderful meal and experience. Would recommend and would come again.

Another amazing experience from the beautiful decor, to the top-notch service, through the delicious food, and ending with the Valet Parking attendant bringing the car before I handed him the claim check!
They have something for everyone, so make plans to have dinner at Vetro right away!

The service was superb, the food delectable and the venue divine! I ended up going 2 days in a row - Saturday for dinner and Sunday brunch. Different friends joined me each time and everyone had a blast. The Dragon’s Breath cocktail was a show-stopper!
Delicious food and wonderful service as always   It’s our favorite restaurant

We ate on the patio.  The weather was terrific so sitting outside facing the water was lovely.  We watched planes take off from JFK, and watched boats and Jetskis as well.  The food was fantastic & the service perfect. We ate so much we didn’t have room for dessert.  LOL.  Next time I intend to have dessert. The patio can be closed in on colder or hotter days and the music was nice & relaxed.  Loud enough to hear but not too loud as to be annoying.

I attended Vetro for my birthday celebration with friends, and I had a great time. We were seated outside and the view by the water was beautiful. The appetizers, drinks and entrees were wonderful. I will definitely come back again.
Great atmosphere and food was delicious. Service was great. Will definitely go back.

Everything was great, but second time coming here and noticed the wait staff is taking on too much at once.  Waited long periods for server to come back to the table.  He was in a rush to hurry away from your table likely because he had too many other tables & a private party.  You need more waitstaff, especially when there are private events during dinner hours.
Great service as always. Food is mouth watering and always a special treat to dine here.
Vetro is always a "go to" place for lovely ambiance, excellent service and terrific food.
The food and service were outstanding and for a special occasion they put every effort to make it special.
Great food. Great service. Very nice place. A little on the expensive side.

First time eating dinner at Vetro. Decided to dine on the outdoor patio. There is AC and Fans to keep air moving and an awning so you’re not baking in the sun. Opted to order off their celebrate summer pre-Fix menu - $38 and you get an app/entree and desert.
Had the Cesar salad and fried calamari which was cooked PERFECTLY!  Entrees were the Sunday sauce and Chicken Giglia.  Desert was cheesecake
It’s a gorgeous view- yes you hear the planes and the jet skiing but it just makes it all great!
This was our first time there. We will definitely be back. The food was delicious and the service first class. Our waiter, Gianni was  great. Very attentive. Great experience!
Everything was amazing , they made our special occasions (we were celebrating 3) even more special and amazing. Vetro by Russo’s on the bay gos above and beyond. Can’t wait to go back again.
Always a good meal at Vetro. Staff is friendly and accommodating. Never disappoints.

Vetro is exceptional in service, ambiance and the choice of various menu options is beyond excellent.   Anything the Russo family does is the best.  The outdoor seating in the summer...  you forget your even in Howard Beach.  5 Stars isn't enough!
Always wonderful my top restaurant to go fit all occasions.
Always a great experience!! Food, ambiance and service always fantastic!!
Service was timely and elegant. Atmosphere was quiet and classy. Loved it!
Excellent food and service and decor!!!!!!!!!!!!!!

It was my first time there and I ate at the outdoor seating area which is so beautiful. The view of the water is breathtaking. There are some flowers near the parking lot and it looked so nice. The food was delicious and there was a DJ there playing some great music. The service was excellent and the waiter checked on me a few times, which was nice.

Had a fun Birthday Party Brunch. Good service. My avocado toast had no egg. With burratta  cheese and some arugula. Hardly any avocado. But they brought some more. Very accommodating. Apple crumb tart with Ice cream. I Couldnt find the apples.  But we had a great time dancing to Nicky G.

This is the first time that I have been to dinner at Vetro, and the service and food did not dissapoint. It was a little noiser than the brunch service because there were many graduation dinner celebrations. However, you are able to have a conversation with your party without shouting.

A big shoutout to Tia and Terry for being so kind and accommodating on a very special day! They went above and beyond from the very first moment I spoke with them. We started as a party of 4 to celebrate our daughter's graduation and asked if we could bring another family that was also celebrating. They made it happen and I will always be grateful to them for helping us make wonderful and cherished memories for years to come! Exceptional service in an absolutely beautiful atmosphere! Thank you to the Vetro team!
First time visiting Verto, and I'm looking forward to another visit.  Great food,  great staff and  overall a great dinner.  The entire staff was professional and attended to our needs.
Great experience. Food and service was excellent. We

My husband and I were taking our son and a friend to JFK and we had time to kill. So we looked for restaurants nearby and decided on Vetro. From the minute we got there, everyone treated us like royalty. The food was super delicious and we were surprised by the portions of the prix fixe menu!  We took home leftovers!  We didn’t feel rushed in anyway. We can’t wait to go back again when we pick up our son!
Jerry our maitre d' was exceptional in every way. He went above and beyond to make sure we were taken care of during our visit.
We enjoy going to Vetro.  From the owner to the waiters all are polite and attentive.  The food is great Thank you
Wonderful dinner as usual, and service is top notch.
I’ve been coming here for years to celebrate birthdays and anniversaries. The food is incredible but it’s the service that keeps me coming back.
Restaurant was lovely. Food was very good but small Portions. Limited restrooms. Great experience. Would definitely return.
No complaints - service was great as well as food!
We like to visit this fantastic Italian restaurant whenever we are flying from JFK.
A very enjoyable brunch,service was excellent .. will definitely go again !!
Went for our anniversary and we weren’t disappointed! Staff was amazing and went above and beyond to make our night special! The food was incredible! We will definitely be back!

The food decor and service is good but the place has a strange vibe.   Lets start with number 1.  The bartenders in the lounge should be younger and more attractive and have great smiles.  Number 2. Sometime I see people in the lounge area with small children.  Lounges are for adults not children.  Overall the vibe is not cool like Cippolini in Manhasset.   Need to try to get a more attractive crowd in there.   Also the girl at the reception with the red hair was blaaaaaa.  This is a service business people that work there just need to make the experience better.
Beautiful restaurant, delicious food and staff always make you feel special.
Service was outstanding. Food and drinks were excellent. I came all the way from New Jersey and will be back
Impressive service. Lamb chops and swordfish were especially incredible.
Vetro is always a great spot locally to have amazing food and great service. This is always my choice for a impromptu date night in the neighborhood.
Would recommend for any occasion. Service and ambience was on point.  The Food was excellent and amazing service.  Thank you for making my sister's birthday special.

It was the first time my wife and I have been here and it was for her birthday and we had a great time start to finish. Service great. Food likewise. Pasta so fresh and delicious. I wanted more! Went to the lounge afterwards and that was a vibe. Had a couple drinks and chilled out. We will be back for sure very soon. Thanks for the experience.
We always have a fantastic dinning experience. Vetro made it extra special for birthday Celebrations and gave it an extra special touch. Thank you for a great time!! We'll see you next time.
The food is always good . The service is always impeccable
The food was very well prepared and delicious the service was outstanding this place is highly recommended
Very nice meal and very friendly staff. Booked on open table and I guess this gave them my bday so they had some confetti and a card for me when we arrived.  Just a nice touch.
I ordered the Australian lamb chops the special they were the most delicious lamb chops I ever had.

Vetro continues to be one or our favorite place to dine. We are always welcomed by name and are treated like royalty. The food, service and ambiance are outstanding! This place is a great choice for celebrating a special occasion or just a special date night. We highly recommend it!
Dinner was wonderful; the food, service and ambiance were of the highest quality. The bottom line, however, puts a damper on the likelihood of returning anytime soon.
Pure our waiter was very nice.  Didn’t rush us.  Food selection for Sunday Brunch was nice. Specials were oysters n lobster tails.   Sounded delicious

We were a party of 4 for my husband's birthday 🎉. The facility provided confetti on the table and a hand written card for him which I was not expecting... But he really enjoyed it! Mario as well as well other staff members were very attentive but not intrusive, which made the experience calm and enjoyable. I'm truly grateful for the wonderful service and perfectly crafted dishes, as well as the valet service. They were kind and efficient. I highly recommend
Never disappointed! From the ambiance to the greeting of the staff to the superb menu. Everything is above expectations. I feel at home.
Manager  was excellent. Service was always top notch. Food was delicious. Wonderful dining experience
Amazing restaurant! Everything outstanding from the food, ambiance and service! A Manhattan restaurant in Howard Beach!!!

Had a wonderful experience at Vetro for my Birthday!  Beautiful ambiance, five star service and delicious, quality food!  They decorated my table with glitter stars and a Birthday card, outstanding attention to detail for special occasions! Will definitely be back soon!
I celebrated my birthday with my family the food was amazing. Great service
Great food and wonderful service  we enjoyed everything about our dinner
A beautiful and memorable evening. Food was amazing, service and ambience the same. We will be back.
Actually my 4th time here. This time was for a birthday celebration and everything was just over the top amazing. Food, drinks, service, anything you name it, so amazing!!
Went there because of the reviews but wasn't overly impressed with the food.
We visited Vetro for my wife’s birthday and had a great time. Service was top notch and very attentive. Food was great and extremely well presented

Service is very attentive , the food nicely prepared and presented, but could have been hotter. The prices are reasonable for some dishes, the specials a bit exorbitant. If you want to enjoy a special dinner or celebrate a special event, this is the place to go.
Excellent food! Great service! Elegant restaurant.

My waiter, Mario, was abrupt and quite rude. When we initially sat down, I asked him a question, and he cut me off and walked away as I was speaking. Sadly, I watched him bend over backward for every table he waited on except for ours (most were a party of 4 vs. our party of 2). I had to ask for water three times, and when he filled my glass, which was a small glass to begin with, he only filled it halfway. Some parts of our dinner were rushed, and getting water seemed like a burden or chore to him. Everyone deserves to be treated and waited on with respect and dignity. He avoided eye contact with us and looked away anytime I raised my hand to signal him because I had a question. The other waiters and busboys were super helpful and kind. Had it not been for them, Mario would not have received a tip, but I understand that the tip is shared with the staff, and I did not want to punish them for his poor behavior. Thankfully, the manager was very gracious and kind and immediately addressed my concerns.

A beautiful restaurant and the food is tasty. They take a lot of pride in their operation and it shows. We went for Thanksgiving and enjoyed it. We wish there was one than one choice for appetizer and dessert. Choosing your entree was great.  You will enjoy it!!
Have not been to Vetro in a while .  The food , service and drinks were all outstanding!!
My wife and I had a wonderful dining experience at Vetro! Our head waiter, J.P. and his team were very attentive to our needs.  We also had a visit from Pure, the manager who was extremely welcoming!
Vetro is amazing!! The service and food are always top quality. Can’t wait to go back!

My visit to this restaurant was truly delightful. The service was exceptional, the food was delicious, and I must say that the drinks were quite impressive as well. I'm looking forward to returning for another round of their delectable dishes and fantastic beverages.
This was my second visit and it’s wonderful, the staffs are very professional, definitely a place to recommend, I give it 5 stars
It's always a great time/meal at Vetro!
On 10/4/24, we had the Shrimp Tacos (a must!), Tagliatelle, NY Strip Steak, Filet of Sole, & Cheesecake. All delicious!
Service was top-notch! Decor beautiful!
Vetro is the place to go!

Atmosphere was nice, food was good. The host “Pure”was friendly & made us comfortable. However, my husband & I waited 30 minutes after reservation time to get a table. We were placed in the lounge to wait & saw an empty table available but assumed that it was reserved for someone else. After 30min of waiting , we were placed at that same table. That was not a way to start off his birthday celebration . The whole point of a reservation is to have the table prepared and ready upon arrival. The young lady(hostess) offered us to eat outside we declined. If we wanted to eat outside, we would have requested it. Horrible experience & it was our first time at this restaurant. The owner came out & greeted us, very nice of him but I didn’t not like the fact that the young lady in the front made us wait 30min for a table that was available from the start . Reservation time is 6:30pm, we arrived at 6:20pm. At 6:36 hostess told us “just a few more minutes” , we were seated at 7pm. We were hoping for a better experience.
The baked clams oreganata are really, really, good and they are a meal in themselves.  I had the black ink pasta with lots of seafood and it was delicious.  Can't wait to return.
I greatly enjoyed my time there, the food was delicious.
excellent food, ambiance and service.  Mario was on point in ensuring that our experience was pleasurable.

V-ery E-elegant T-rully R-eally O-riginal Thank you Ricardo for an amazing dining experience yet again . We dined with our daughter Zoe which had so much fun , she loved the food . Vetro is an institution and dear place it holds in our hearts . Kindly, Daria & Edy
Amazing place and great service.   Highly recommended!

We came in from MN for our 25th wedding anniversary dinner and to attend the US Open Tennis Championships.  We could not have made a better choice for our Anniversary dinner.  The team at Vetro made us feel special, Ricardo, Tasha and the rest of the staff we outstanding.  Thank you so much!!!
Beautiful Restuarant and excellent staff service but the food portion is just too small for the price.
Thank you for time.
Always a pleasure dining at my favorite local restaurant. Everyone is kind and professional.

Music was just a little to loud at one point. Vetro’s never disappoints with the food. The baked clams are always outstanding. Everything we had was delicious. Frank was there with his son and he made his business to stop at every table and talk with everyone. We always enjoy going to Vetro’s for dinner.
Great food, white glove treatment!! Magnificent ambiance.

The food was amazing. The staff left a card and stars on our table for our anniversary. Our waiter, Juan Pablo, was very good at his job and had much patience with the table next to us who began to give him a hard time. We will definitely come again.
Love the outdoor patio area for a summer brunch! Vetro is a great hidden gem in Queens where you can relax by the waterfront.

It was our anniversary and when we got to our table there was a note waiting for us wishing us the happiest of anniversaries with a glass of champagne for us on the table.  Now that’s class!  We were seated at a very romantic spot inside the restaurant, we enjoyed our cocktails, appetizers were delicious as was our dinner and dessert.  Not our first time here but I must say it was our best one yet.  The staff is always amazing and most accommodating.  It was so enjoyable.  We will definitely be back again and again!  Thank you all for such an amazing evening.
We enjoyed a lovely birthday dinner celebration outside and the food was exquisite

Been here before, great food, great ambience and the service is superb.  I was never disappointed when I dined here and my guests were pleased too.  Valet is another plus.  Keep up the good work and thank you for your excellent service!
Loved the ambiance. Service was outstanding. Food was good but not exceptional and too cold for my liking.

We had a great experience at Vetro this past weekend, from the moment we pulled up to the Valet. Everyone including the host and waiter was fabulous the service was outstanding by them all. The food and energy of the restaurant was amazing.
Came here on a Thurs. evening. Love the outdoor dining option with the water view. Great place. Food is decent and drinks are good.
Always love eating here. Staff is always pleasant!
The experience was really good.  We both enjoyed the setting. Good service , food,  location and overall ambience.  We'll definitely  recommenf to friends. Thank you.
My absolute favorite restaurant! Everything is above top notch.

The menu they had for brunch was delicious! Definitely recommend the rack of lamb they had. They also made sure to give a nice card and congratulations for the birthday which was appreciated. Plus, they give a chance for you to go take pictures outside by the water which makes for a great backdrop.
Beautiful waterfront restaurant! Brunch and dj!! Great time !
The food was excellent and the service was pleasant and knowledgeable.
Wonderful food, atmosphere and service. A short Uber ride from the TWA Hotel/JFK and worth the trip to avoid settling for airport area food.

My first time here and I have to say , it’s one of the BEST restaurants for a birthday celebration. The service, food and ambiance was unmatched. It’s fine dining at its best and the staff made our visit so memorable, I will definitely be coming back and spreading the word.

The service was excellent from the front desk to the lounge! Our server Pure was wonderful. Very attentive and made sure our party had what we needed. The good was fantastic. Well seasoned and cooked to order. Great time had by all.
Always top shelf food and service great specials and fabulous wine
Always impressing! I brought a friend/real estate broker who has been talking about it forever. He was very happy.

EXCEEDED MY EXPECTATIONS! Reserved a table for two to celebrate my fiance's birthday and they were very attentive to my special note "BIRTHDAY CELEBRATION" that to our surprise we found a Happy Birthday card on behalf of the Vetro staff! Incredible detail and made us feel very special. Valet parking was quick and effortless. The receptionist was very kind to also consider my note "window seating" and arranged accordingly. The floor was staff was very attentive and table was kept clean at all times. Cocktails were refreshing! Dragon's breath was well presented and very aromatic, aqua dolce was delicious, and the moscow mule was beyond refreshing! We enjoyed the grilled octopus and russo's bites as apetizers. Main courses were Mushroom Rissoto - first time I ever had rissoto and my taste buds were going CRAZY! Delicious tase. Main courses were Chicken toscana and Speciality plate Branzino. We topped it off with Apple crumb dessert and a Casa Amigos shot on the house for the birthday man!

THANK YOU VETRO LOUNGE FOR SUCH A DELIGHTFUL EXPERIENCE. WE WILL BE BACK TO TRY OUT THE SUNDAY BRUNCH! A must go to if you want the ultimate Italian Fine Dining Experience. 100% SATISFIED. 6 stars out of 5!
Sincerely, Paula G.
I never leave reviews but we enjoyed this place so much AND front desk was very accommodating to my reservation changes last minute.
Great service. The risotto balls were delicious. Unique desserts. A great place to celebrate a special occasion.
I had the pork chop and it was delicious. My daughter had the filet mignon. She said it was perfect.
Honestly I had no expectations and it was awesome. Loved it.
Always delicious food, friendly service, attention to details.
Amazing experience; our first visit.  Everything superb, can’t wait to return!
Vetro is a culinary treat for the Rockaway and Queens. I have enjoyed many a special event here and have never been disappointed
We love it there. The best fine dining outside of Manhattan
First time having dinner here. Excellent waiter and service. The food was outstanding

Vetro is an upscale dining experience from the start. The entire staff was very professional, friendly and helpful. Our food from appetizers to dessert were expertly prepared to perfection. We will definitely be back
The food could have been better. However, it was not bad at all. It was enjoyable. Just not absolutely and unequivocally delectable.
Never disappointed when dining at Vetro! Impressed from the time greeted by valet. Menu and drink options are amazing! I would give Vetro’s more than 10 stars!!!
Dinner was delicious. Had the filet of sole. Cooked to perfection. Wait staff very attentive. Overall all experience was fantastic❤️
Outstanding service and food from this old world classic. What customer service use to be about.
Terrific service, amazing food. Everything from start to finish was spectacular and we will definitely be back. We were there for our anniversary and they made it so special for us. HIGHLY recommend.
As always .. excellent food & service . Disappointed that Sunday brunch has been discontinued
Vetro is the best restaurant in Howard Beach. The food is delish & the service is fantastic. PJ is just the nicest host

Vetro is a GEM! We had a wonderful evening celebrating my husband’s promotion to a new job at work. This is a restaurant that adds special touches I don’t see others do. The team decorated the table, congratulated my husband throughout the evening, and they checked on us to make sure we were having a good time. Our waiter was excellent, the food was excellent, and the ambiance was excellent. The dessert at the end with sparklers- just wow. Seriously- we had a great time and know we’ll be back.
Great food and service. Wonderful receptionist. Modern music
The service is old-school wonderful. The food is delicious. And the wine list can’t be beat! I highly recommend Vetro’s.

Easter Brunch was excellent my parents and family enjoyed it very much The service was great and friendly Only note I have is that if you want to order outside the brunch menu it is not allowed. We always enjoy Vetro’s and will be coming back for more soon.
Food was excellent and amazing service!  Our waiter was attentive and informative of the menu options and specials. I will definitely be back for another visit.
Nice ambiance, great food and good service. Highly recommended I’m coming back next week.
Had a great time meeting my friend.  The service, food, drinks and staying to dine in the Blue Room was special and attention paid was worth it.

Brought my friend and her husband for her birthday dinner! My husband and I dine here all the time and knew they would love it. We ordered seven appetizers (some twice), split two entrees and two pastas followed by dessert, espresso and sambucca! A fabulous time was had by all!
Excellent staff, delicious food, very clean and well kept restaurant.

Vitro by Russo’s on the Bay is a favorite of mine for many reasons… The ambiance is soothing with soft lighting. The linens are soft and the table setting is just the right size for a comfortable eating experience. The chef cooks the most delicious appetizers of fried calamari and rice ball specials. The chef is spot on with the entrées of linguine with clams floating (yes floating) in a garlic white wine sauce and a scrumptious pesto spread grilled chicken cutlet with garlicky broccoli rabe and melted mozzarella on crusty bread roll. Their tiramisu is STELLAR!!  Server (Mario) is conscientious, pleasant, knowledgeable and charming.  Many many thanks from one happy and satisfied patron

A very pleasant surprise not far from JFK. Unexpected excellence. Great food, extensive choice of good quality wines, and excellent service from the team. We were staying at one of the local hotels around JFK and felt hungry but the reviews of all the hotel restaurants in the area were quite negative and so we widened the search to somewhere within a 15 minute drive and Verto's was an option and after reading the reviews we thought we would give it a try. It even exceeded our expectations. Must try the oven baked clams and Mixto Frito as starters. And on top of it all there was a special offer of 50% off all wines up to $250 per bottle. Couldn't resist and ended up topping off the great food with an amazing wine Tignanello 2018 that worked out at only $100  USD for the bottle. The building and the interior are built with panache, and that goes a long way against local dining scene, mostly confined to unremarkable venues. Personnel was smartly dressed and exceptionally courteous, a nice change. But here too, one finds room for improvement - Service was slow. Overall, Vetro is still by far the best venue in the area, but young startups should be unafraid to beat it on food quality and variety, and also better service. The food and service were both impeccable. Would highly recommend for anyone to try.
Everything was beautiful!  The rice balls were delicious but the portion was quite small.
From the minute my husband and I walked into Vetro, until the minute we left, we felt special! The staff is professional and the food is top of the line!

Everything there was amazing from the good to the restaurant staff. After dinner my girlfriend and I went upstairs to the lounge for a couple of drinks. The staff up there was excellent as well. The only bad part which wasn't the restaurants fault was the promoter. I went to go use the Atm and as soon as I came back I saw he approached my girlfriend to try and take pictures of her. I'm not really sure if he was the promoter or not though but either way was uncomfortable. But outside that everything about this place is outstanding I would go back.
Always perfection! An experience that never disappoints.

Although I selected "date" for occasion, all apply to Vetro. We enjoy just dropping in on a busy weekday for a great mood lifting dinner. We always take out of town visitors there, just to impress them. We also enjoy spending special occasions at Vetro, where they treat you like royalty, but still with a friendly hug. They never disappoint!!!

The moment we walked into the restaurant, we were greeted like we were family!  We had an incredible waiter, Julian.  He was very knowledgeable with the menu and thanks to his expertise, my family and I, were able to make our choices for Brunch.  The entire wait staff were very accommodating, polite and friendly.  We felt like "Royalty" - the entire restaurant was beautifully decorated and impeccably clean.  The aura of Vetro's is special and  unique. The food is delicious, and presented beautifully. Thank you for a wonderful dining experience!  We will be back and can't wait!

We were very pleased by the food, the service, and the personal attention. The fact that wine was half-priced on Wednesdays was a pleasant surprise. Although I grew up 3 miles away 55 years ago, I never had been here before. It is close to JFK Airport and I expect to return.

Our last visit was in January. Unfortunately we did not receive the same service. We had a thin black man that barely tended to us, we waited forever for food and drinks and he had a snappy attitude when we asked the bus boys or whomever was around for a drink or bread because he couldn't be found. We are not complainers by any means. It was 2/14 I believe so although it was a holiday and there were holiday specials he charged full price for certain things on the special menu and overcharged for food we didn't receive. I had to  ask 3 times to revise the bill. We still overpaid but we gave up paid and left. It was disappointing. This is by far our favorite place to dine, especially beautiful and romantic. We've referred endless friends and family there.,we also have considered out engagement and wedding to be held there. This last visit just rubbed us the wrong way.

Can't say enough about Vetro! Everything is perfect from the moment the valet greets you until your server hands you the check. The staff, the ambience, the chefs amazing creations and the incredible bartenders delightful mixtures, they never cease to astound be. Open Table patrons, make a reservation and prepare for an incredible evening!

While the decor may be a little overstated for some -- restaurant is very ornate! -- the food and service are incredible. Food is innovative and imaginative without being weird, and if there's a traditionalist in your group, he or she will be satisfied too. Great classic dishes, like rigatoni bolognese that's unsurpassed, but some more original offerings too. Exceptional seafood.  Not cheap, but not outrageous either, with a fine selection of wines by the glass.  Because it was an anniversary dinner, wife and I got a complimentary package of cookies to take home...a nice, thoughtful touch, compliments of our very thoughtful server . Service was extremely professional, never intrusive, always attentive. Really, I cannot recommend Vetro highly enough and I can't wait to go back.
Lovely dinning experience. Fine service and great menu selections. Very classy without being stuffy!  Highly recommend Vetro
From the valet to the waiter  everyone was amazing.. The service was awesome!! My waiter was Steve and he def made great referrals off the menu and we were very satisfied..

From the parking valet to the busboy, all of the employees we encountered were pleasant and courteous. The menu choices were varied and the service was prompt and efficient. The food was delicious. A little on the pricey side,but worth the occasional treat.

I was very impressed with Vetro. I loved the ambiance and enjoyed the selection and quality of food offered. Excellent customer service as well. I would definitely recommend this place to friends and family.
This restaurant does not cut any corners. Their attention to service, food quality and taste, presentation and décor is outstanding. Vetro is truly a gem in every sense of the word.
Service was impeccable. Prix fixe brunch delicious and filling.  Abundant menu with varied choices. Adorable desert plate.  Loved it. Going back soon!!
We were seated an hour after our reservation. Dinner was finally served 1-1/2 hours after that. Not happy about it. Very upbeat and fun but we have no need to return

My husband and i went to Vetro for our 15 year wedding anniversary. From the first minute we walked in to our last we were pleasently suprized. We were greeted by a wonderful and very helpful hostess, after by a friendly great waiter (Michael).  The restaurant decor is beautiful and tastefully done. Everyone was super sweet and nice to us and made us feel very special on our special day.  Food was good desserts were great... reasonably priced. 5 star place. Looking forward to go back. (((:

Everything at Vetro by Russo's on the Bay was perfect. Tia the hostess was extremely courteous and considerate of our seating location; as one of the members in our party was wheelchair bound. She took the time to give me choices as to where it would be most comfortable for us to sit. We were even allowed to enter the restaurant dining area through an easier entrance through the bar. Our server Michael, was attentive and informative as he gave us dining options and came over quite often to see if anything was needed. The food was exceptional, and all staff were very respectful, considerate and accommodating. I highly recommend Vetro by Russo's on the Bay.

I go to Vetro several times per year and it never fails to disappoint.  Yesterday, I went for the Bistro Lunch and this will now be added to my list of where to go to for lunch locally - reasonable and good!
Great food and outstanding service. Would highly recommend
The hostess actually checked my seating preferences and sat me at a table with a great water view!
Everything was great, from the time we arrived until we left!! Celebrating my wife's birthday in style, the service was outstanding, food was great and a tremendous wine list!!

I had fried calamari for an appatizer, and was disappointed w/it, it was chewy and tasted like something you'd get at a bar, my tuna dinner and wine however were excellent, Julian, our waiter was fantastic , I'd recommend Vitro, w/out the calamari

unfortunately this attractive restaurant has a lot of room for improvement. We have dined there a few times hoping the next time would be better, i.e. The bread wasn't good ( in a neighborhood where you can get fabulous bread). The chicken scapiello was dry and the halibut portion was small. The veal chop was good but $49.....too expensive, just like the cocktails.
We would like to see this place succeed in a community where restaurants are scarce.  The neighborhood needs a place with consistently good food and reasonable prices.

Lunch was excellent,  lemon fillet done to perfection, moist, flaky,  delicious on top of spinach.  Nice white wine selected for me by Julian.  Chef's selection of dessert of the day, mini canoli, chocolate cookie and a chocolate ball infused with rich creamy chocolate and drizzled plate with strawberry/lemon syrup.
Departed full and very satisfied. Don't forget to try the patio dining.

Vetro continues to meet the high expectations and standards.  The food was delicious again.  It was a popular evening, so a bit crowded.  The wait staff did a fine job keeping up.  We celebrated another birthday with that giant candle!  Thank you.

I have made Vetro's my special spot to take family and friends for Sunday brunch no matter where they are visiting from, or celebrating any special occasion, as long as Vetro's is open for brunch we will be there.  Delicious food, great ambiance and excellent service.
Beautiful waterfront restaurant. Expensive with so so food. Noise level from the club upstairs was unbearable.
We were very pleased with the total experience. The ambiance, food and service was impeccable.
Food, service, and ambiance the best!😄

The food was very very good. waiters and staff were by far the best i have ever experienced from any restaurant.  The only negative is that there were not many options for side dishes and not many different entrees

Had a group lunch there for the first time and I was not disappointed.  Outside seating area was nice and picturesque.  The food was good. We got a different menu from what we saw online,  and an item from the menu  which we wanted was not available. Some members of my party felt the waiting  time between courses were a bit lengthy. Overall,  they liked the place.

I went there on  6/19/15 to celebrate a special occasion with my wife. I have to admit that the whole experience was wonderful. The food was exquisite, the atmosphere was welcoming and the service was great.

I have always enjoyed brunch with friends. Yesterday I brought my husband. He liked it so much he wanted me to inquire about having his birthday party at Vetro's. Unfortunatly no one from the banquet department has gotten back to me.
Good food, service was a little slow..
Sitting on the terrace for lunch was cool and comfortable and scenic,service was outstanding
The Menue was great,The food was tasty, wine great,, staffing was friendly and attentive
This is my second time here and this by far exceeded the first experience. The staff was superb.  The food was excellent.  My whole family agreed that we will definitely be coming back.
I have been coming to Vetro since it opened and I am always thrilled from the food to the service.  I would recommend to anyone.

I been to Vetro many times and it never disappoints. The Veal chop was amazing and grilled octopus is to die for. They have one of the best wine lists in any restaurant in New York. Looking forward to my next trip back
I have been to many parties at Vetro but this was my first time at Brunch for a birthday celebration. It was wonderful! Even better than the parties! The staff was amazing and we had a great Sunday.
Going back for sure!

Vetro continues to be my favorite place.  I've celebrated birthdays here since its opened.  The food is always delicious and service impeccable.   Extensive wine list and several choices by the glass.  Lunch provides a healthy portion.  Our waiter Michael treated us special on a birthday occasion with an interesting twist to a candle on dessert.  Thank you.

It usually takes awhile to be seated but we don't mind. We alwasy visit the bar first. Gorgeous lounge area, great bartenders and comfortable atmosphere. Always feel like a special dinner when we are there. Vibrant crowd, people are dressed nicely and the service and food is outstanding.
Love this place and I have never been disappointed. The whole staff is excellent.  Anything you order is delicious!

My friends and I  went to Vetro for the Prix Lunch Special  for the month of March. The food was prepared to all of our  needs  and the portion size  was perfect, there was even some to take home. The staff was very friendly and helpful with the menu item questions.  I would visit Vetro again.

Went out as a party of two to celebrate a career milestone.  From the moment we walked in we were very friendly greeted and offered the opportunity to check our coats and umbrella.   The waiter did an excellent job at offering wine selections, and ways to tailor some meals so that they are vegetarian.  He even discreetly asked if we were there for a birthday celebration, so that we wouldn't miss our opportunity.  Just the right amount of attention was offered without hovering.  Our bread was brought out on time, water glass filled at the right moments, etc.  I would definitely recommend this place, and it's a gem in Queens.
It's hard to top the quality of the food and service at Vetro.  Been many times and continue to go back.

This would be my second time @ Vetro's and each time it gets better starting from the atmosphere and the attention to detail the stafff gived you and to top it off the waitor we had "Puro" is amazing very profesional . Every time myself and my coworkers comes back either for brunch or dinner we always ask to sit in his area.

The service matched the fantastic food as well as a beautiful dining room. I can't find anything negative about our night there. We were a table of four with an infant and they made us feel extremely comfortable. Teal was also wonderful in answering the million questions I had for her. All in all, Great place.
Friendly, attentive staff. Good food. Restaurant was very clean.
Vetro is my favorite resturant - the food, service, drinks, always exceptional. Typical of the Russo's brand. I have been here many times and they never disappoint / the bonus is its so close to home

I've held couple of events in the Murano room, but never patronized the restaurant. Very elegant, great staff, delicious food - especially the Cream of Mushroom soup and Lemon Sole Francese.  This is definitely one of my favorite restaurants.

Usually one of my favorite restaurants. Unfortunately this time the food took almost an hour to come out and when it did I asked for my lamb chops medium rare and they came out well done. It was also freezing inside the restaurant. Frank usually doesn't disappoint, but this time he did.

I usually go to Vetro for dinner on special occasions. It's perfect for celebrations because they always take care of you 100%. I went for my birthday and they gave me a card after dinner. This time I tried brunch. Brunch was impeccable. It's a three course meal with a complimentary brunch drink and you feel like you're really as 5 star restaurant. The service is perfect and this time I put on the open table reservation that it was my anniversary and without question they brought me and my girlfriend a gorgeous and delicious dessert with a huge candle in it to celebrate. This place is wonderful.
Absolutely love this restaurant, have been there multiple times and will continue to go!
Teal was magnificent and out server Ricardo was awesome. Outstanding.

From the moment the doorman opens the door for you till the owner comes over to your table towards the end of your meal your dining experience is fabulous!  The ambiance is simply gorgeous and elegant! The food was terrific! And the service is impeccable! The attention  you get from the waiter, the busboys and the hostess Teal (her name) is unmatched! It was the most pleasurable dining experience I've had in years! Who needs Manhattan! This is definitely the place to go! Although I live in Brooklyn this will be a regular dining place from here on in! My compliments to the owners and their entire working staff!

We were in a hurry and the servers met our every need. They were extremely pleasant, the service was excellent,  the food outstanding, and the ambiance perfect. We will be going back in the near future when we can fully enjoy this five star restaurant.

If you live nearby, of course it's great.  If you have to travel a bit, it is SO worth it! The prixe fixe menus are excellent and a great value - highly recommend it for your first visit to avoid sticker shock to the a la carte menu.  Wed pm is also great - 1/2 price bottles of wine (some are very reasonable but this is a great deal!).

Choice of appetizers and main course,  eg souo, Cesar,  capresse, fish, sole, burger, cavatelli, etc.  Sole francese was very good and a generous amount for lunch.  Salads always great presentation, and sufficient.   Chef's choice of dessert, cheesecake, canoli, chocolate cookies for 2. Everything else extra, coffee etc.  We started off with wine, expect to pay $$ for that. You do get what you pay for here and it's excellent, but it'll cost a bit. I continue to come here, one of my fav's.
This is a great restaurant for that special dinner celebration, girls night dinner, and brunch.
The staff was great and let us celebrate our friends special birthday for as long as we wanted. Even carried it into the bar.  Great place.
We went there for my birthday and we had a great meal and received great service.

Arrived early. Sat immediately. Service providers were professional. As a peron who dines out no less than three times a week, I found that $75 for a veal chop was criminal. I understand that it was on the list of "specials" but $75...they have some nerve. There are no places in NYC that charge anywhere near this price.

We thoroughly enjoyed our dining experience.  The service was top notch and the food was incredible.  We were not rushed and were able to enjoy the evening of food, drinks and wonderful conversation.  Portion size was perfect and all our dishes were prepared perfectly.  They offered a great selection of appetizers, entrees and desserts.   They even offered a petit size dessert option so we could try a variety of just enjoy a smaller portion.   For all this the price was incredibly reasonable.  There is a great lounge and bar while you are waiting for your party to arrive.

Went for early dinner on a Friday... had a great pre-fixe menu or can choose from large menu.  All the choices were great. We had a drink at the bar in the lounge before dinner... so lovely and pleasant. Meal was delicious.
Delicious food ! Great service! As good as a top Manhattan restaurant!😀
We took guests here and they were very impressed! The staff made it possible to just sit and relax and we had a great as  time  food was amazing the wine was excellent our party had a wonderful time.

I came here for my 22nd birthday and it was really nice. It wasnt really what i expected. I thought there would be more music while we were eating. I have yet to come across an italian restauraunt that plays music like the spanish restauraunts do. The food over all was delicious.

Entertained a client - the food was beyond quality, as was the service and setting.  My guest and I spoke post-lunch about how exceptional the dining experience was - we will both be back with family, friends and more.

We were staying overnight near JFK and were told this was an excellent restaurant.  We were seated right away, served our water and given the wine list and menus. We ordered the mussels appetizer with mushrooms and spinach which we shared, it was truly delicious and plenty for two.  They served complimentary bread and hummus that was very good.  Our waiter, Allan, was very knowledgeable and friendly.  We ordered the Dover Sole special, which we again split and it was excellent and plenty.  Overall this was a great dining experience.
The service is warm and welcoming. The food is OUTSTANDING.
The decor is also a feast for the eyes.

We had a fabulous lunch, 3 courses, and generous serving sizes.  Food is always extraordinary and presentation exquisite.  Service is very personal, top class.  This is a place you will remember forever.  Chef's choice of dessert was pastry, cannoli, chocolate cake.....awesome.  You will pay$$$ but it's very worth the experience.

From start to finish everything was perfect! We were greeted warmly by the hostess, which is always nice.  The waiter and busboy were beyond attentive, especially to my 2 year old daughter who is a handful. The food was phenomenal..the lobster & eggs is a must try!! Can't wait to go back and try the rest of the items on the menu and the view made the experience that much better. Kudos to Vetro for a job well done.
The food was so, so, so delicious....     We have to go to Vetro more often. Service was wonderful - plenty of time in between courses to digest while admiring the extraordinary decor.

To put it simply, it was simply amazing. The staff was so accommodating and helpful. Our waiter explained everything for the specials of the night and answered any questions we had. The taste, prep and quality of the food was top notch. We had a table of seven and everything went without one hitch. I would highly recommend Vetro to everyone.
Celebrated our 10th Wedding Anniversary..the food is amazing; Brian is top notch !!  Ricardo was such a pleasure, very attentive.  Each and every time we are there, it's better than the last.
Definitely a repeat visit.  Can't wait until the roof top opens again!!!
The food was good. But it took them 1hr to bring us our main course and so we decided to just bring it home. The desserts were delicious!!

Returned back for the second time in one week. This time it was for their classy and affordable brunch!! I came with a group of 7 people and everyone was raving about the food and service. My only problem is which is better, dinner or brunch? Either way, you can't go wrong!!
Overall had a great time. Food was very good. Service was on spot. Very friendly.  Nice date night. Can be expensive depending on your budget.
Have gone on multiple occasions - brunch, dinner, holiday - quite simply - Vetro never disappoints!

My wife and I went there for our anniversary and it was delightful. From the minute we walked in, till the minute we left, we felt like royalty. Great food, great service and superb management. I will be going back soon!!!
Wonderful place, Great Ambiance, cleanliness, friendliness, service was top shelf
From the minute we walked in Vetro we were treated with the highest regard. The staff, the service and the food is incredible. Vetro is our new favorite restaurant.
Food is tasty, service is amazing, price is reasonable, atmosphere lovely
The food was great so was the service highly recommended.
We had a waiter named Alan and he was great he was on top of things. the food was also good, overall a great experience.

Everything about Vetro is outstanding.  The food is always delicious and the service seems to be better and better.  It's decorated with great taste......We always have a wonderful experience there and highly recommend it to our family and friends especially for a special occasion....

This was our second time dining here.  We took friends for dinner and Vetro's did not disappoint!! We had a few cocktails in the lounge area then sat for a wonderful meal.  We were not rushed out all, the service was wonderful, attentive but not to the point of it being annoying.  Our friends cannot wait to return!  My only disappointment (which has nothing to do with Vetro),  is that mother nature did not cooperate, it was raining so the rooftop bar was closed.  We will definitely return.
The appetizers, drinks and dinner was excellent. Our server Alex was very attentive and very informative about the dinner specials. I would definitely go back to Vetro by Russo on the Bay.

I was looking for a place to have a party next year and came across this restaurant. Great place , with wonderful food and terrific service from all the staff--- and I didn't have to go to Manhattan or Long Island for it! I will definitely be going back( especially for a special occasion)  and letting my friends know about this place.

From the valet parking to the very end the experience was simply amazing. The service was superb. The food was delicious, delectable and delightful.  The bathroom were very clean and sanitary.  The view was beautiful and even though we were sitting by the water, the bay didn't smell awful.
The foods was delicious and the service was great. We will return soon!

I was invited here by a former coworker.  Although I had been to Russo's By the Bay for several business parties, this is the first time that I visited this restaurant.  It was wonderful from the moment that I walked in.  The staff was friendly, the food was wonderful and the ambience was terrific.  We sat outside and enjoyed a lovely breeze off the bay while we dined on a light and delicious brunch.  What a wonderful way for me to spend one of my last restaurant visits in NY before I move to Georgia!  I'm just sorry that I only now discovered it.

The moment we walked in we were greeted like we've been there a thousand times. My wife and I celebrated our one year anniversary and our waiter Julian made the experience terrific. From the food to the wine we were amazed and can't wait to go back again
The most outstanding dining experience. Everything was perfect the staff was great the food was amazing no need to try anyother resturants I found the one
Every time we go to Vetro is always a great time. From the service to the food, Vetro never disappoints.
The restaurant week lunch is wonderful. It is well worth $20.14. However they make up for it by charging $14.00 for their drinks which is two thirds if the cost of lunch.

We were looking for a special place to celebrate our anniversary and my wife's birthday. Vetro was that place and we were extremely happy with the service and the food. We were greeted and treated like we were very special people and we haven't stopped talking about the food. Thank you to all of you that made our evening very special. And a special thanks to Frank Russo for stopping at our table to see if we were enjoying ourselves.
Attention to detail is fantastic.  The service is top notch.  The food presentation is a work of art and the quality of taste is incredibly fresh.
Highly recommend...loved very dish we ordered. Staff was highly attentive.

I have used Vetro the Murano Room for 3 consecutive years for a special event for my departements. Food and service has always been excellent. So I decided to try their restaurant...and I was not disappointed... Food was once again very good and so was the service. I will definitely go back.

Food was Great. Service was very slow. The waiter barely came over to see how eveything was going. It was so bad my bf got up to get the water of pitcher to pour into our glasses. Later on the manager showed his face more, which made the service a littke better.
Amazing - will come back again and again! food, wine list and atmosphere all fantastic - the drinks at the bar were delicious but in my opinion a bit pricey at $12.00 each
I have been here several times and always the same experience 5 star foor and service
Excellent Food.  It was a delightful experience with very capable staff.
If you've never been here, you must go! Food is tremendous, service was excellent!
The restaurant was very good. Great food and décor, great service, highly recommend
Every experience is a wonderful one for me! From the blue room to dining room and rooftop is so lovely.

Food was very good. Went for Father's Day with a group of 7 and everyone enjoyed their dinner. Only negative food item was the lobster mac and cheese. It was awful...inedible. Need to improve that or remove it from menu!  Went up on rooftop afterwards for drinks and was impressed. Lovely atmosphere and view.

Vetro's was beautiful. I went on Father's Day with my parents and we were seated at a beautiful waterfront table. The food was fantastic, & so was my waiter Alex. My only complaint would be that the patrons seem to have no control over their children, letting them run around as they please and ruin people's dinners, but that is of no fault of the restaurant. Overall great experience.
Our favorite restaurant! We are foodies and eat all over but Vetro is our favorite food,device and ambiance are amazing!

Having spent a copious amount of time in Italy, I am very particular when it comes to Italian food.  Vetro exceeded my expectations.  The food, ambiance and service were amazing.  The meal was out of this world, flavorful, fresh and perfect.  It's exactly how Italian food should be.  Plus I loved the dessert tasting menu.  Well done !
Authentic Italian food but so is the area and you will not be rushed or disappointed in the food and service.
Food, service, atmosphere were sll great. Portion size was nice. Just a little pricey.

We had a very nice time at Vetro for dinner. The food was very well prepared and the service was excellent. I had the lamb chops and they were big, meaty, delicious and prepared perfectly. My wife had the pasta in white clam sauce and it to was a great dish.

I love Vetro. I dined here for my 8 year anniversary and I must say the staff made our night memorable and special. From the hostest to the bartender to out waiter everything was exceptional. The food was definitely beyond delicious. I highly recommend the stuffed shrimp. Our waiter even recommended a special drink order for me and my fiance which was very tasty.  I will definitely be back and would recommend Vetro to any and everyone. Thank you guys for making my night perfect!

The service was outstanding, the head waiter was accomedating and friendly. Each waiter was attentive and lersonal e -tive. The food was excellent. The wine list was a very extensive, but expensive. Will return.
Food was good, beautiful place.  Nice rooftop bar with great music! Great date place!
Great experience.  Only feedback is that it took a long time to get served, but took advantage of that to get to know my date better :)

Finally the season is here where me & my family can once again enjoy all the wonderful things that Vetro has to offer while dining outside overlooking the water. Nice views, cool breeze, great food, service & drinks.
Good atmosphere, excellent food, great service, and the company of the one you love. What more could you ask for.
Great place, great food and terrific service. Its location to JFK makes it a great place for dinner if your staying overnight to catch a morning flight.

No surprise here, Vetro is consistently outstanding! From the warm greeting at the door to the four-star service and delectable culinary selections, you can't go wrong. This is big city dining (think Manhattan or Rome), with neighborhood convenience and attention to detail and customer service.

Vetro is a fine, special occasion restaurant which lends itself well to celebrations, ergo Mother's Day.  The food is always gourmet-worthy and the service is comparable.  Although somewhat more pricey than the average, neighborhood "gem", every aspect of the "dining experience" comes together perfectly and makes for that "special occasion" feeling.  Highly recommended.
The food was amazing but the service was superior!

Vetro was an excellent dining experience. Everyone in my dining party was extremely pleased with their meal. I had the Pork Osso Buco and the meat just fell off the bone and was delicious. Highly recommended.

Everything was great, the food was delicious , the service was super. Everybody was friendly and attentive The only issue was that we were celebrating my sisters birthday and the fact that she was pregnant and I wanted our table to have an outside view to make the occasion memorable and we were told the tables were already taken. The main reason why I chose this restaurant was for the view and I was kind of disappointed

My fiance and i went on Sunday just the two us of for an early dinner being. As soon as you drive into the parking lot the valets are there with a smile gladly to help and take care of your car. The doorman is very friendly. This place is beautiful you walk in to a friendly concierge who seats you in an elegant dining room. Once seated the staff were so attentive and friendly. A must try is the Sunday Dinner it is outrageous great homestyle italian gravy. The oso bucco is to die for and the salmon with risotto is amazing. There is not one downside about this place. The service and food was great!!
Great for special occasions and staff was wonderful. Thanks again.
We had a wonderful Easter Sunday dinner experience. The food was delicious and abundant, and the service was impeccable.

Attention to detail from the moment we walked in.....impeccable service and exceptional food. The waiter was extremely knowledgeable about the food and wine menus and was very helpful in accommodating my wife's food allergies to garlic and onions. No request was too much for the chef to handle The staff made this a night to remember. .....
I've been to this restaurant a few times before including Christmas Eve and have never been disappointed. Food is consistently good. Service is always excellent. This is one of my favorites.

Dining at Vetro is always outstanding. The awe-inspiring measures taken by the staff to ensure your visit is memorable truly make your day. This is a place to dine for those who want a fabulous meal provided by a skilled chef, in an elegant space and served by an efficient, caring staff.
This is our favorite fine dining restaurant. The food and service are impeccable. PJ is an outstanding sommelier and maître d We love everything about Vetro !
loved the resturant,service excelled--will be back

I chose this place to have a small celebration. Parking and coat check is complementary and the staff were friendly. Our server was very knowledgeable, and answered any questions we had. The food was AMAZING, it was an ultimate dining experience. The ambiance was wonderful; there are quiet partitions to the dining room which give a quiet and intimate vibe.

Being from Las Vegas we eat at a lot of the best restaurants. We also ate at a couple of well known restaurants in New York recently. Vetro by Russo's was hands-down the best food we have had in the past few months. Finding a 5 star rated restaurant close to the airport was surprising. Little did we know how surprised we would really be. Tele (hostess) made sure we had a great table and took care of us throughout the meal. The service was outstanding, the staff very friendly, and the FOOD was just spectacular! Great Wine. This restaurant has gone out of their way to create something unique. It is obvious they hold themselves to the highest standards! And, I have never taken the time to review any restaurant. Anthony and Eva

Took my Mother for her birthday at lunchtime. Service was impeccable from the maitre d' to our server. I beleive we even chatted with the sommelier( not sure-he didnt say, we didnt ask) about the great wine selections. The food was to die for. The greeter (sorry dont remember her name) was very gracious and kind to us. The doorman was nice and very funny. Even my finicky-eating son tried different menu items not of his usual choosings. My retiree friends and I decided to go to Vetro and I'm so happy we did. They offered us the Restaurant Week Menu and the choices were more than I've seen at other restaurants. Everyone from the top to the bottom are so awesome Good is great Brian Alan Luke and all the other waiters r great Food is Awesome wine is fabulous atmosphere beautiful
Every time we go to Vetro we have such an awesome experience Staff is just wonderful. That is why we frequent so much Wine selection awesome atmosphere great love the place

Lunch at Vetro's is always a great afternoon. The food is delicious from apps to desert, the wines are delicious . The service is excellent, they always make you feel special. In the warm weather, we go there to have lunch on the water, always a good time.
Went for lunch and it was a very good dining experience.

From the moment you enter you are received with a smile. The waiter and busboy were wonderful and attentive without being intrusive. The dining area is very elegant and romantic. The food was outstanding. I have been to vetros for many occasions but not the restaurant. I would definitely return.

Nice setting and seated right away with reservation. Service was great with constant attention without being rushed. Ate from the prix-fixe menu , meals were great. I had Sunday Sausage and my wife had the shrimp dinner. Cocktails were good and dessert was also great.
Great place for brunch.  The food was very good.  And beautiful décor.  I would recommend.

After our 3rd time dining here, Vetro has still found a way to exceed our expectations. The food and ambiance were simply amazing but the service was beyond compare. I wanted to celebrate my boyfriends birthday at a romantic place. Vetro's was outstanding. Your table is far apart from the others which gives you privacy. It's very quiet with Italian music playing. He is looking forward to returning to experience the rooftop.
The best restaurant from the food to the ambiance to the staff!
The managers pj and charlie are amazing!! The waiter was very attentive!! Overall the place is a great experience!!
Food great, service great prices a bit high

The evening was very decadent , They made me and my family feel very welcomed and attended to . The environment was quite calm and reserved with soft music playing in the background. Everything about the atmosphere was perfect. If you are looking for an elegant way to celebrate a special occasion or have a romantic dinner for two this is the spot . Food was divine, dessert was heaven and the staff were angels I felt like a goddess for my birthday

A Manhattan quality restaurant right here in Howard Beach! Vetro never disappoints, as they make you feel like you are dining at a classy relatives home. DO NOT MISS THE CHICKEN FRANCESE MEATBALLS!!
Great food, service and atmosphere.

Valet parking, a doorman that actually attentively opens doors (so rare in NY), maitre'd greeting, coat check.....A memorable evening. Lovely Italian music. Nice ambience. Service to die for. Food was pretty good but the only caveat, we all felt our dishes tasted a bit salty, still, not a major problem. Wine is pricey. Have the sole, octopus and risotto.
Had a excellent dinner, with great service.

Went back to Vetro and the food was magnificent as always. We explored the wine list and really found some gems in there collection. Some people might find it a little pricey but well worth the money for the food and service. i would highly recommend this place especially if you want to impress someone.
Love this place! Only issue is pics with Santa - very unruly children. I don't blame the restaurant - I blame the parents.
We came for my friends 50th birthday. The staff food and service was perfect. We will definitely come back! Thank you for making the night memorable.
This place is great in the great upcoming Williamsburg in Brooklyn. The service is great. The prices are a bit pricey though. The view alone is worth the visit to this place.
Been there several times. Would highly recommend this restaurant, whether for occasion or a gathering or just for a quiet dinner. Lounge is relaxing, singers are always good.
The manager PJ is the most personable host we feel so special there

First time visit due to location. Chianti was excellent. Hot appetizer and tuna tartare perfect. Lemon sole was fabulous as were the pasta dishes and mussels. Will definitely be returning and highly recommend
We love going to vetro because the manager PJ treats you so special

The food was superbly prepared. Our server Julian, was most helpful and professional. He offered suggestions and made our dining experience even better. We have been here other times and Vetro never disappoints.
One of my favorites, consistently provides outstanding food, expeditiously and without the pretentiousness.
My wife and I went here to celebrate our 26th Wedding Anniversary. The staff treated us like royalty, the food was delicious, the atmosphere was romantic, and we had a great time.

We recently had a birthday dinner for our daughter and was not disappointed in Vetro . The menu was interesting and diverse . The food was delicious from the appetizers to the dessert ! We will definitely return at some point in time.

Took Mom for 91st birthday. She thought it was elegant.

Great Food; Homemade Pasta; accommodating to gluten-free and had excellent gluten-free pasta. Delicious chicken and shrimp entrees. Beautiful presentation. Attentive staff. Dessert sampling amazing. Definitely will return.

My baby and I spent hours looking for a place to have dinner. We wanted to go to a place where the food would be a hit rather than a miss. After searching the web for more than two hours and re-reading the reviews for Vetro's we took a chance. I've gone to Russo's for weddings and hoped and prayed that the food at Vetro's would be as good. We did have some reservations even after making the reservation. Well let me tell you. Luke was our server and he was outstanding! It has been a while since we had oustanding drinks and food. I am very happy that we've found a local fine dinning place because the ride to NJ to the Chart House was not the best move on a Friday night considering the traffic.

We went for our anniversary dinner. We were seated at a window table over looking the water. Service was friendly and professional; a nice pace, water glasses were never empty, the food presented elegantly. To start we had orecchiette with sausage & broccoli rabe in a garlic sauce, and mozzarella in carrozza "Fiorentina". Both were excellent. For dessert we had the Cannoli Sundae. It was served it to us with a sparkler, a very nice touch. The service was 5 star - attentive and professional yet friendly and approachable. The place is beautiful and comfortable.

My husband made a reservation here for my birthday. We are from the South Shore of Staten Island so we traveled pretty far but it was totally worth it! We definitely would not mind making the trip again for a date night.

ALSO...great Party rooms...and lounges.

All the small dishes were excellent. I love Octopus and they really knocked it out of the park. Ordered two servings!! Service was excellent. Our waitress was friendly , knowledgeable and attentive. We had a great dinner before heading over to the Kimmel Center for a concert.

We had perfect weather and really enjoyed the outdoor seating area. The food was excellent. The service was very good and the waiter friendly and helpful. The Sunset Dining Price Fixe menu had plenty to offer and is a great deal at $28. We will most definitely go back.
the manager is so congenial knows who you are knows most customers by name

Staff, food was excellent. Great waiter and staff. Highly recommended.

This was our first time at this restaurant. We were there for our anniversary dinner. This is the go to restaurant that NEVER FAILS to impress. The amazing food, attention to every detail by the staff and the overall appearance of the venue, everyone feels special. The staff makes note of your likes and dislikes, menu items ( or specials) you want to try on your next visit, etc.
My wife and I got married at Vetro so we return to have dinner on our anniversary. Dinner was great but the company was much better...
Everything was just fabulous. Food and service couldn't have been better.

Vetro was a great place to eat, drink and be merry. The menu was jam packed with great favorites. we ate off the fixed menu and was impressed. The deserts were to die for. I would recommend it to everyone!!

Fabulous food and great atmosphere made for a wonderful evening once again.

We have been there before and had a great dinner and this was no exception. Especially the menu for restaurant week was so worth it. The sunset was sublime on the terrace; you must sit out. Great service!

Vetro never disappoints. From the food, the atmophere, the waiters, the hostess, they are all great! I love going to Vetro. If your ever in Howard Beach, this is the spot to go.

Food was excellent. We were seated outdoors at out request. Once you enter the restaurant you feel like your in a beautiful resort. After we had dinner we were able to enjoy drinks at the rooftop lounge with live DJ and dancing. Great time! Great Place!
this place is the real deal a scene out of the good fellows it's awsome can't wait to go back thank you guys your the BEST
Very nice experience overall!!!!!!

The only dish worth raving about ! Very disappointing for this new venue, with its lavish decor, fun vibe all party mode at bar section. This big place has strong bones and could be very good....... if they work the kinks out in the kitchen !!!

The atmosphere, service and overall dining experience makes Vetro the perfect choice whether you just need a night out, or you are celebrating a special occasion.

Don't leave this restaurant complaining about the price because you will not find a finer place. Water always full, dishes taken off promptly and the tables were cleaned off after dinner was done. Highly recommend Beautiful atmosphere delicious food and attentive staff .

Next time I will when it is nice outside so I can enjoy the beautiful view. U had no regrets and would recommend it to anyone for any occasions. I loved the Decor!!

great food, great resturant a must try.

I felt like I was talking with a friend.

The service was great however no one offered us a drink while we were waiting for our table. We waited in the lounge room and saw everyone around us being offered drinks. The TV in our section was an eye sore and wasnt even turned on it took away from the ambiance. Our waiter was great and the food was yummy.

Our excellent waiter recommended the special that night-Tuna steak with braised endives on cannelloni bean purée.it was so fresh and perfectly cooked and flavorful. Apps and desserts were of the same high quality. Presentation also earns high marks at Vetro. We are never disappointed there.
As always the food was delicious and the service was great
Never once felt rushed. Had a meal in 2 hours that some other places will force you to have in 45 mins. Bring out each appetizer ad its own course, new place setting for each. Food was delicious.

Many thanks for a wonderful evening filled with fine wine, unbelievable food and impeccable service by both captains and bus boy ~ Brians' food recommendation were spot on, Alan's wine service was better than an NYC restaurant and Amed's attention to detail enhanced our evening besides keeping the table super clean.
