As usual had a great dinner with great service. Never disappointed when I dine at Vetro. Looking forward to the nice weather when we can come here & sit on the outside patio. This place has it all.
Always a great dining experience. The staff is excellent.

Excellent service and the food was extraordinary! We were never left unattended but yet no one was overbearing!

Our favorite neighborhood restaurant! All around terrific! Beautiful venue on the water and the food is excellent, the service is always wonderful. Great sunset price fixed menu. Delicious brunch.
Everytime I go to VETRO it is such a great experience. The food is so delicious and the service is always amazing!

I rated my dining experience at Vetro Very Good. My only issue was that Open Table and Vetro advised us that the first available reservation was at 8:45pm and we were seated 30+ minutes later. Vetro gives Open Table their availability and I felt it was not as accurate as it could have been.

This place has no high chairs, so I don't know who wrote "kid friendly" The meal was very good, but expensive. The push for appetizer, salad and desert. My second diet coke was an additional 6 dollars. This is a nice restaurant but prices out of my league. We love to eat outdoors but this restaurant is situated on an arm of Jamaica bay. While waiting for my car We watched so fellows on jet skis. The smell of gasoline and the bay was not appetizing.

I had a great time at Vetro again. This is the best restaurant I have been to in a while. Everything about Vetro is good from the servers to the food. The waiter we had was very friendly and courteous. He was this way because he wanted to and not because he wanted something back. After a great diner we went upstairs to the roof top lounge for some good drinks and great music. I would recommend everyone to check out Vetro.

The food was exquisite. The service was up to par and the place was immaculate and romantic. My husband and I were celebrating our 15 year anniversary and I hope to visit the same place next year. Or another Russo on the Bay delight.
Very good food--excellent service. Will definitely return

My favorite part about Vetro was the rooftop lounge upstairs. The view is great! We went during latin night which was full of energy. I would definitely recommend this place if you are with a group of people looking to enjoy the nice weather, have some good food and a good time.
As a regular patron of Vetro, my dinner guest and I had a great dining experience.

Top notch Italian...refined service...fair prices...excellent wine list..noteable bread basket. What more is needed for a superb dining experiance. Joe has the right suggestions to help you through the extensive menu then delivers unobtrusive service.

Vetro never disappoints!! Went for a late lunch and sat outside for 4 hours. Nobody wanted to leave!! The food was delicious as usual and Brian our waiter made some great summer wine suggestions. Can't wait to return for another beautiful afternoon on the water!!
We love veto! It's our favorite ! The food is amazing, and so is Joe, our waiter.we will only sit with him , he is just the best! He makes our dining experience perfect in every way.
Delicious food in a lovely atmosphere. Went to the roof top bar after dinner for a drink...lots of fun!
Great place with lots of amenities and fantastic food.

From the moment you walk through the door which was opend by a doormen, to the receptionist who told us that half our party was waiting in the loungeuntil we were seated everyone was as nice as the could be. Table service was a pleasure From appetizers until the end of our dinner. By the way the food was excellent.

The staff and the service were amazing! Our head waiter went over almost Half the menu with us. Made many recommendations and there were plenty. The food was delious! And the lounge on the roof was beautifully decorated the DJ played classic disco and classic hip hop to great hits of today. Will definitely be going back.
We had a great time and very testy food!
Service was a bit slow but the sunday sauce was worth the wait.
I booked my wedding at Vetro for October of 2013 but I hadn't tried the food yet. A friend of mine and I went for brunch this past weekend and it was DIVINE!!!
The service is impeccable. I've never been to a place where they dote on your every whim.
The asparagus and lobster salad is absolutely something to try, the gnocci is delicious and the "Opera trio" cake was the perfect ending.
I can't tell you how many times I will be going back with my family, friends and fiance....before and after the wedding!
Bravo Vetro!

Went to Vetro with some business associates who were staying near JFK Airport. Food was excellent with many unique choices such as their chicken francaise and chicken marsala meatballs which we share as an appetizer. Great idea and very flavorful. All entrees were very well presented and tasted great. The entire staff from the valet when you park your car to the hostess and the waitstaff were professional, friendly and helpful. If you are near JFK, and don't wish to travel far for great food and ambience, Vetro is the place for you.
Once you go to Vetro you don't want to dine out anywhere else. You get so much attention you think you're the only ones there. Manager PJ is very congenial remembers your name.
Again, a Wonderful Evening..Thank You !!!

Great first impression. This is the first time my husband and I ate in Vetro. I must say we eat out a lot and we were extremely impressed my not only by the food but by the staff as well. We were treated wonderfully!! We will be going back for sure and we are bringing our friends with us.

We had a thoroughly delightful brunch here after my daughter's graduation. The service was top notch: friendly, attentive and informative. The food is delicious and well prepared, and the price was reasonable. Brunch includes one Bloody Mary or Mimosa, and a choice of appetizer (try the chickpea app) and entree. I will definitely go back, and not just for a special occasion. Make sure you take the elevator to the top and check out the roof top bar.

This is the best restaurant I have been to in a real long time. Everything was great from the server to the food and the drinks. It has a great outdoor dinning area that oversees the bay and is very romantic. When I was there they had a wedding party going on in one of the rooms and everyone seemed to be having a wonderful time. The best part for me and my wife was the outdoor rooftop lounge with a bar and DJ. We realy had a wonderful time and this is our new spot.
Had dinner once but it was every enjoyable so we will more than likely return in the future.
Fabulous dining experience. Love the taste, it was incredible.

I have been to Vetro several times and am very partial to the restaurant because I personally know several of the employees. The staff there works so well at what they do and make you feel so warm and welcomed. Chef Michael never disappoints in the food. I absolutely love the place and all that goes along with it....from the elegance to the comfort.
Beautiful restaurant. Excellent service and delicious food.
Took my mom for Brunch. Food is excellent with Service to match
Excellent service, excellent food.

BLAH, OVERPRICED / OVER SAUCED FOOD, / PUSHY WAITERS GETTING US TO ORDER MORE...FIRST APPETIZERS /THEN DESSERTS AFTER WE SAID "NO" 3 TIMES... NOTHING SPECIAL.. WE LIKED GIARDINO'S IN DOUGLASTON SO WE CAME HERE CANT BELIEVE ITS THE SAME OWNERS, WE HAD NOT BEEN THERE IN AWHILE SO MAYBE THEY HAD DIFFERENT MANAGEMENT A FEW YEARS AGO
Great place for a special occaision.
the Burrata was great. Very friendly service.
Love everyone there..I feel like family..I enjoy every moment here..thank you
We loved the food! We went for lunch, and had a great experience. Amazing service..

The dining room is a bit dated. The service was not formal enough for the prices, it was a little too 'fuggagedaboutit" style service. The food was uninventive Italian specialties, but they were prepared quite well with high-quality fresh ingredients. Portions were TGI Friday's size. The surrounding area was dumpy and ugly, however the restaurant itself was clean and well staffed with uniformed staff.

This place was great, the lounge had a guy singing music while we sipped on our drinks waiting for out table. The wait was not long. When we were seated the waiter was awsome!!!! We had crab cakes and the lobster artichoke dip for an app, the meal was great all around. This may be the best resturant we have been to. We will be back in may to check out the roof lounge when it opens.

The food and service was very good. The only disappointment of the night was the loud music coming from the bar lounge. It was difficult to hear each other at the table. The live singer was performing the doors and rolling stones, which by the way I enjoy, however not in a beautiful upscale place like this!!

We Celebrated my father-in-laws birthday and we had a fabulous time. Everything was perfect. The food, the service, the atmosphere. We could not have asked for a better time. The lounge was a great place to meet and have a drink before dinner and then the singer that night (Maurice) had the lounge so revved up, we couldn't pass up going back in there after dinner and joining the fun. Great night out!!
Foods and service is wonderful as always! Wine Wednesday is a great, can't wait to go back!!
I just love it there..everyone treats you great

The baked clams and Salmon were superb. The focacia was very good. As well as the wine. My party loved it, overall it was a very good experience. The one think I would have preferred is to have the party table by the water or in the main dining room. I did not care for the conference room, which is right by the kitchen door. I was facing the kitchen door, and every time a waiter came out it was a little bit unpleasant to look in the kitchen. I detest that view. When I go to a restaurant, I do not need to be facing the kitchen. All the other rooms are by far more pleasant to dine in.

Everytime we go back,it's gets better and better,and the service and staff is amazing! Noel the bartender rocks!great place to celebrate a special nite,or to have a great nite out with friends and family. Going back soon!
very good food....probably some of the best in this part of Queens...
The food is really good (especially the lobster ravioli) and the atmosphere is good for groups or even a romantic date.
As a regular guest at Vetros, my friends and I were not disappointed. The food and service were great! Enjoyed my birthday lunch immensely.

The new menu items are amazing. We had the Crab cakes & the Crab & Artichoke dip for appetizer. I'd love to know where they buy the olive oil that they put on the table, its the best I ever had. It must be expensive.

The Service was Great, The Food Oustanding. Will defenally Go back for seconds.. It was our first time at Vetro.. we had invited a friend out to dinner for his birthday and they made it so special for him. The staff was so professional and friendly from the  valet attendant to the coat check personal and all in between.
The new menu items are great & the chef specials were amazing.
The food and wine, atmosphere was wonderful! But what made our night great was our waiter "Joseph". He was well informed, attentive and fun. We would go back just to see him!

Food ok, service not so great. the server kept forgetting to bring our drinks. I was drinking white wine and I thought when I ordered a glass of wine they should bring a clean glass and not reuse the one I have been using for 3 hours. I do love the atmospher and the lounge is very nice.
The food - always the first criteria - was incredible. The ambiance was very comfortable, the lounge area was very relaxing and elegant. Our maitre'd was very attentive and helpful.
Vetro was a nice dining experience. staff very friendly and professional. i enjoyed the food and the dessert was delicious...
The food and service are worthy of Michelin stars and this is NOT an exageration. The menu is inventive, far from standard and the food is absolutely delicious. The service is outstanding.

I've eaten here dozens of times before, but this was the first time that I ate with such a big group & the service was as good as ever. We left the appetizers up to the waiter & everyone chose their own entree. They had some amazing specials for the night as well, we will definitely be back.

Always a distinct pleasure. Been there many times. Will go back many times more. Vetro has that rare combination of exquisite atmosphere and superb food. Hard to find a restaurant anywhere that can do both as well as Vetro does. Highly recommended.

wonderful retaurant! great food, great ambiance & great for a romantic dinner. The veal chop is a must. Extensive wine and drink list. The food is so wonderful and the service is beyond any other in Queens. They have a way of making you feel special each table has 3 people serving you. This is a must go to...........

Great food and service. Lounge can get a little corwded and noisy with people waiting for party rooms to accommodate them. The place has a terrific rooftop bar in warm weather, and the bar menu is every bit as good as the fantastic restaurant menu.
Always a wonderful dining experience..top notch, professional and sincere.
I absolutely love this place its my third time there first time in the red dinning room...I think its a great Destination Restaurant..we come from Westbury....its amazing
Celebrated my daughter's birthday. Food was tasty. Our Waiter was very attentive.Lobster Ravioli was a highlight.
Very Good our waiter was also excellent!
As always, my dining experience was outstanding
great place for a special occasion or for a group of friends.good wine, good manager service. would go again!

This was my second time at Vetro's and I was still impressed. We were a party of 6 celebrating my mom's bday. We were seated at the exact the time that we made the reservations. Wonderful experience. It's a little pricey, but perfect for a special occasion. They will also alter meals for you. For example, my dad wanted something w/out the cream sauce and broiled, and it was done to perfection.
Took my wife there for dinner on Valentines Day. Nice atmosphere and ambience. Prices were not as bad as I thought. Food was incredible!!!!

This was our first time dining at Vetro. It was Valentines day and i was alittle skeptical of how the service would be since it was a holiday. Well i was pleasantly surprised. From beginning to end i couldnt have asked for a better night. Our waiter Joe was excellent. The food was unbelievable. I would highly recommend this restaurant for their excellent food, great service and beautiful decor.
Beautiful place and very good food

My fiance and I went to Vetro for Valentine's Day. The food was delicious and the ambiance was perfect. The service was top notch and the singer was entertaining. We have decided to have our wedding at their sister location, which is Russo's on the bay. Both venues are perfect for weddings and events. They both have exceeded my expectations. Thanks Vetro for getting a hold of a rose that I requested for my fiance! They go above and beyond to satisfy their customers. We look forward to spending many anniversaries at Vetro. ~A~
A very pleasant dining experience, service was outstanding, food presentation was tastefully done, served at a perfect rate, we never felt rushed or neglected.
The Valentines Day Menu was outstanding. The executive Manager makes sure to always make you feel special and is so personable

Vetro is consistently great. The more you go, the more you love it. PJ and his staff go out of their way to make sure you and your guests enjoy your evening and make every effort to make it special. The food is unique and the combinations are anything but ordinary and yet somehow they work. Chef Michael puts food combinations together that are totally unexpected and they explode with flavor. The wine selection is second to none and yet never intimidating. The lounge area is eclectic and inviting. Everything is outstanding. And when the summer months come and the roof bar opens, it's even better. There is no competition.

Food was spectacular, service was outstanding, never once did I ask for my water glass to be refilled or anything else. They were super attentive, waiter was friendly and pleasant. He made us feel relaxed and never once rushed through any part of our meal. I cannot wait to go back!
The new chic pea spread recipe is amazing...
Good food, Good Service. Helpful staff. Beautiful setting. Not too pricey. All good.
Great food, attenive staff, will return for sure.
This restaurant ranks up there with some of the best I have ever been too. Food is outstanding, the restaurant decor is beautiful and the wine list is one of the best I've seen.
Our waiter Brian was both Charming & Efficient. His recomendations for wine & appetizers were great. He made our evening special.
We were at Vetro's to celebrate our 51st. anniversary. We enjoyed outstanding food and exceptional service. We plan to have a luncheon at Vetro's in May for our granddaughter's communion.
Great restaurant, great food but expensive so be prepared to pay for it.
Great restaurant, fantastic food and a really great wine list, one of the best lists I've seen!

Decided on Vetro for my 30th Birthday dinner. From my first steps into the lobby, to drinks in the lounge (with Peter and Jimmy) and dinner (with my fantastic waiters Joe and Brian) overlooking the water, Vetro was an amazing experience and i highly recommend it to any and all looking for a top notch evening.
Food is outstanding as is the attentive service. Considering having a family member's wedding here.
One of the best in the neighborhood.  Food, service and ambiance are superior.
Food was scrumptious, staff was excellent
Beautiful venue on the water. Best kept secret for fabulous price fixed weekday lunch. Gorgeous decor! Great service and food. Manhattan in Howard Beach.
We had a 4 course meal including surf and turf it was phenomenal and the service was outstanding.
As always i wasnt disappointed. I took my mom for new years dinner. She had a blast.dinner eas great.dessertcould Have been a little better on prix fix selections.
No one will fail to enjoy this excellent restaurant. A must place to eat for all.
Had yet another great dining experience at Vetro. Went with 2 young children this time and Everyone was very polite and accommodating as usual. The food was delicious as usual. Will be back soon.

I have been to Vetro twice and both times have been outstanding as this review states. The service is impeccable and the food is prepared beautifully. The lounge area to wait for your table has a really nice vibe and ambiance to it and on Christmas Eve they had a lounge singer which was perfect. This is quickly becoming a favorite and i can't wait to try out the rooftop when the weather is warmer.
Friends had recommended this place, and the food was excellent. We went on a quiet Monday night, so not sure how it would be if busy.
Food was absolutely luscious - Can't wait to return to Vetro.
The food was delicious. Personally, I did not like the inside decor. It looked more like a pan asian style than an italian restaurant. i did not go upstairs to the bar as it is winter.

I had the Lamb Special, it was out of this world delicious and my husband had the pork osbocco, raved about it, excellent food, excellent service, The executive Manager was very attentive and made sure everything was exactly the way we wanted it

We have been to Vetro many times. This time we decided to bring the kids to brunch with Santa. As usual our experience was fantastic! The kids were treated great from the coat check helping them on and off with their coats to having their pictures taken with Santa. We all loved the food and can't wait to go back. Thanks again for a memorable experience!!
first time for a special birthday dinner and we were very happy.

The restaurant was lovely; elegantly decorated, the food & service were both EXCELLENT! The price was good too; we were a party of 3 and 2 of us ate off their Sunday menu which included an appetizer and entree for $28.00
This was our first visit, but definitely not our last visit. We have already recimmended Vetro to other friends.
had brunch on a sunday afternoon it was delish. staff is very welcoming and attentive ambiance is great and they dont rush you out. i sat there with my sisters for almost 3 hours.

Amazing from the time we pulled up to the time we left. Perfect in every way. Food was incredible, waiter was incredible, the menu was outstanding and an overall perfect night for my wifes birthday. Thank you. Highly recommended.
This was our second time there. Great food. Can't wait to go back.
My husband and I dined for lunch. Great service here food was amazing- cold antipasta was plentyful and very fresh, lobster was sauteed with garlic, olive oil and chili peppers.
So glad to have this place in the neighborhood.
Food was Good the service was Better!..just a little to noisey!
Delicious food and excellent service. On the pricey side...so for me it's a special occasion place.
The food was delicious albiet pricey. It is a great "date nite" place or for a special occasion. Julien our waiter was very professional and the service was impeccable.

Amazing food and customer service from beginnig to end. My husband and I went to Vetro for a date night, we bought a coupon from opentable but I left it home!!! When we arrived at the restaurant- the hostess was very friendly so I decided to tell her about the coupon and she said not to worry. She asked if I had the coupon on my phone or the ticket number. I gave it to her and she made sure the waiter applied the coupon to our bill. Our waiter, Al, was excellent;friendly, polite and gave us suggestions as to what dishes to order. We will definitely go back, we want to try their Brunch.
I have been to this restaurant for almost every occasion (wedding, brunch, dinner, lunch and even a cooking class!!!) I have yet to be disappointed. Please add them to your list of places to visit.

Food was quite delicious and waiter was very knowledgeable about the menu and food offerings. Menu had an array of options. Food arrived promptly and was quite tasty. Portion size is quite generous and I found myself too stuffed for dessert :-(. Nice neighborhood option.
The manager at Vetro is the most congenial and accomodating man, He oversees everything and never seems to miss what someone may need
Overall, the food was very good. For appetizer, we had the mussels in white wine sauce. That was very good. We also had the clams and sausage as an appetizer. That was just ok.
Our two main courses were Lobster Ravioli, which was probably the best Lobster ravioli that we ever had. We also had the Chilean Sea bass, which was also good.
For dessert we had the brownie, which was just so-so.
The service was very good. Prices are a little on the high side.
Our waiter was exceptional! Thanks for a nice evening dinner...it was surely worth the trip from Westchester!!

EXCELLENT FOOD & SERVICE. Waiter,Joe,was very friendly person. I ordered the surf & turf which came w/ a jumbo prawn. I dont like to see the whole prawn, so I ate the rest of my dinner, and at the end of my meal, I asked the waiter to deshell my prawn thinking I would take it home bec. had plenty to eat already.  When they returned my plate to the table, they included on my plate another serving of veg. & potatoes which basically gave me a full meal to take home. Total unexpected & a great customer service perk.  The manager, PJ, was the next to impress. My friend was trying to pay w/ a prepaid card, and the waiter could not get card to work. PJ came to the table w/o prompting from waiter, and figured out the problem. Highly Recommend.

Went to celebrate my engagement with my BFF and asked her to be my matron of honor. Great afternoon until we got the bill. The waiter kept bringing bellini's without asking. We thought they were unlimited with brunch. When we got the bill, we saw they weren't. I was shocked! I paid the extra $30 b/c I didn't want to ruin a great afternoon and the waiter did bring us dessert comped (even though we didn't want it)but this left a bad taste in my mouth. I had been several time before and this never happened.

It is by far my husband and my favorite restaurant -- it's not dinner out --- it's a night out. There are not many restaurants in our area where you can relax while being given excellent service and food - Vetro is it.
Enjoyed my meal thoroughly. The price fixed menu was diverse and the portions very generous. Great waitstaff, especially our waiter, Julian. Would definitely go again.

Food, and Service were exceptional. My husband still keeps talking about how great our food was. We had the fresh Tagliatela pasta ,and the grilled octupus for apitizers, he had the fresh tuna which was made with a fig sauce(amazing) and I had the fish from New Zeland also great.Can't wait to go back. Thanks again to Julien our waiter for explaing the menu to us .
Been here several times, food taste and portions have been consistently great! Great ambiance.

This was our third visit, and least favorite experience. Cocktails not properly prepared - Manhattan was served without the cherry, which was requested, and a very dry Martini tasted of vermouth, not pleasant taste. Also, we waited a long time for our cocktails to be served, in the meantime the waiter asked if we wanted to order; so we felt rushed, and it was a Wednesday evening. Menu selection was expansive and interesting, but the food was a disappointment. Appetizers in general were okay, except for an order of croqueta de maria, which fell flat with very little stuffing. Also seems like the same sauce was used on the order of cannelini and on the chicken special. Cannelini didn't hold their shape,it was only meatsauce,no bechemel.

recomended by friend ...had a great waiter but 3/4 empty and the host tried to sit us cramped in a corner with a rolling tray and walls surounding us. Food came out in what seemed 30 seconds.Appetizers were delicous and the main dish nothing to brag about. Again the main dish came out in 30 seconds also. Jumbo shrimp wasnt jumbo and the pork dish I ordered was like shepards pie and bland. Bar ran out of certain martinis which in mnht would have never happened in real fine dining. it was ok but definately would not go to again sorry. it was like a catering hall at a wedding(with the great appetizers and not so great dinner)..... it was just ok

We have eaten at Vetro over 3 dozen times and each time has been better than the last. Last night we ended up trying all of the chefs special instead of ordering from the menu, what a good decision. Kudo's!!!

Had the opportunity to dine for lunch and dinner within the same week.  Lunch wasn't as crowded as dinner, and I don't understand why. Choice of 2 lunch menus - one was a set price with 3 courses for $20 - amazing.  Some of us chose this menu, while the rest of the group went with the standard lunch menu. The lobster bisque cappuccino was packed w/ huge chunks of lobster.  Nice lunch on the water.

Dinner was fun - we had the birthday packge  It was super organized.  4 of us had a set menu of familystyle appetizers and choice of 7 entrees. But that's not the best part - the package offered my friend her own bday cake, bottle of champagne for the grp and a HUGE venetian dessert course w/chocolate fontain/fondue. Best Value THanks PJ

Went for dinner late on a Sunday afternoon, ambiance is beautiful, food was very good, service was wonderful, and they had a very talented performer singing, really added to the specialness of the meal. I would definetely return!!
Just an excellent restaurant all the way around. Food, atmosphere and service. Will be going back none too soon.
great outdoor seating.... the food was great
Our host accomodated us very well for our 15th wedding anniversary
Celebrated my birthday there with my family this week. First time there and I really loved it. The food was delicious, the menu had such amazing choices, the service and ambiance were terrific.

Russo's always = 1st class.  Our table was not ready so the host sat us in the lounge and had us order cocktails on the house, which is so classy and rare these days. Food is always great, service is sometimes forgetful though.
Very nice wine list ... attentive service but not hovering ... rooftop lounge is attractive and enjoyable
We enjoyed a wonderful evening at Vetro. The food and service were excellent and we would recommend this restaurant to everyone.

This was the second time that we dined at Vetro's and we were certainly not disappointed! The first time we ate inside and the second we chose the outside patio. I would absolutely recommend the pork osso buoco, chicken scapariello, and the veal chop capriosso. All outstanding!! Our experience on both ocassions was quite enjoyable. Would definitely recommend this restaurant.
I would definitely go back again.

The food here was great. The service was great as well. The place was a little on the noisy side so hard if your looking for a romantic evening. Very nicely decorated and easy parking. Lots of great items on the menu to choose from.
The Lobster Cappucino was fantastic...I can still taste it. Waited almost 15 minutes for a drink refill.
Beautiful venue and decor. Like eating Manhattan. Outstanding service. Great price fixe lunch. Very accommodating waiters.

This place is totally a hidden Gem. Roof top is beautiful, it has an awesome happy hour and music is really, really good. I went on Latin night. Had a great time. My husband and I had dinner there as well. Great food and service. Can't wait to go back.
overall we had a terrific experce,from the lounge to the restaurant to the rooftop bar. Our waiter was superb and we can't wait to go back!!!!

This place is OUTSTANDING! The food is absolutely decadent & the service is remarkable! You will not find a place with this type of top-notch service, I guarantee it! The rooftop bar is absolutely beautiful. This is a MUST if you love authentic Italian food with a real high-end wining & dining experience! It won't cost you an arm & a leg either!
The atmosephere and service was great. The portions could have been bigger for the $$$.

Cool rooftop deck. Food was great. Decor was nice. They cut corners on the staff. Waiter brought our pasta after we had our main course (it was supposed to be after appetizers) and then wondered why we didn't want it anymore.

The decor at Vetro is so beautiful that you think the food can't possibly be as breathtaking as the design but you would be wrong. The osso buco was so delicious as was everything else. Our waiter was freindly and professional, and the wine list superb.
Great place, Great food. Will definitely be back.
Once again Vetro managed to impress!! Pasta with Clams out of this world!! As usual the service was warm and welcoming! Can't wait for our next visit!!
very beautiful . great food , nice view..
EVERY THING WAS GREAT, JUST LIKE BEING IN A FAR AWAY ROMANTIC RESORT.
FABULOUS FOOD!!! GREAT PLACE FOR A SPEIAL OCASION!
Wonderful time. Food was fresh,hot and was timed for an optimum experience. I am looking forward to going back many times in the future.

Everything at Vetro’s was exceptional: Food, service, etc. The only thing we wanted was a seat near the window. Instead we were near the kitchen, in and out in and out, in and out all night. We finally got use to it. Maybe we sat in a section for large parties because we had a party of 7. By the way gratuity was not included in our bill. I thought that was unusual, but we gave our server a very generous tip. Maybe Vetro’s can have a large party sit by the view (window) or outdoors. Anyway, we had a great time

The food was very tasty...the service was very good/fast...but the room was blah...no atmosphere... we faced the red brick wall...we could have been anywhere..not at vetro though..I expected the atmosphere to be more romantic..even though seated inside we could have been seated by the water...but a party was going on..so we were stuck in the corner...

Outstanding food, service and ambiance. We will return with friends in the future. Ours was a quiet, family dinner celebrating one member's birthday. The food was first-rate and, most importantly, served hot.....as it should be. Well-done.

Our party of five truly enjoyed the variety of appetizers, we shared five different appetizers, and each one was delicious. Four out of five had seafood, which was also very good. We were celebrating a friends birthday, she was given a complimentary birthday dessert. We plan to return.
Excellent Food, Great Dining Experience, Very Attentive Service, 5 Star Restaurant Experience. Highly Recommend. Prices are Not too bad. Great Selection on Menu.

It being Memorial Day I understand it was probably busy as it would normally be. The menu is awesome, as was my waiter, very accommodating and attentive, then the spinach salad and fried calamari came and it was just perfect, followed by a basic chicken franchaise that seemed a bit different, a little sherry demi-glaise, very nice touch and my Linguine White clams was absolutely delicious, simple but perfect. The elegant dining room with it's plush colors and fine finishes gives it a classy feeling, yet relaxing. I will be raving it up with all my dearest friends, and, I can't wait to get back and try some other things on the menu...
Beautiful view!! Wine a little expensive. Food excellent. Would love to see more seafood on the menu.
I was very pleased with the service and the food. Definitely am returning

Our server Jeanne was menu savvy and energetic in her service skills. She sold us on the Angry lobster - sauteed with garlic, olive oil and chili peppers - amazing. This chef does more with Lobsters than Ive seen even on the west coast. He's so versitile. He even came to the table to greet us.
Love this place, love the outdoor patio and the rooftop lounge was hot.
This has been the best restaurant that I have been to in a long time I eat out 4 times a week. The service was superb I would and have recommended it
Good spot for Howard Beach residents! I would go back to sit outdoors for lunch.
Never disappointed....The tuna with figs, honey and onions was incredible this evening!!! Loved it :) Cannot wait to enjoy the rooftop lounge this summer
This was a perfect place for mom on Mother's Day. It was busy but not chaotic like other places can sometimes be on such a holiday.

Took Mom for Mother's Day for the second year in a row. Mom usually like to stay home and cook her own Italian food, but she enjoyed Vetro's last year and this year did not disappoint. Wonderful food and service. No rush, no waiting to be seated, and the menu selection for entree's was great.
Expensive but elegant, Service is efficient but cold & impersonal
Although we were seated at a less than desirable table, we had a good experience overall. Our appetizers, especially the lobster cappuccino, were fantastic.

The dinning area for walk in's had no windows to look out at the water. There were no tables for two that we could set side by side . For a Italian restaurant there was no dishes with pasta and it was Friday night and there was no dancing . We had a great night in spite of the short comings .
Love this restaurant, staff is always so attentive, the food is excellent and the Manager is so warm and friendly, you feel special there

This was a return trip for me an my family. We started w/ drinks on the rooftop open lounge - it was a bit breezy, but the views were excellent of the bay. Their rooftop lounge is just something I would not expect in Queens.

We had dinner in the main diningroom, which was soooo nice with the live music - great touch. I had the special - Angry Lobster. It was sent to the table on a huge platter -grilled with garlic & Oil and chili peppers. My family enjoyed the service - pleasant and attentative. Besides the lobster, I love the wine list. The prices are very fair, some bottles were as low as $38, which enabled us to select a different bottle with each course. Looking forward to my next visit.

The food and ambiance was fabulous! There was a greay vibe in the dining room and the keyboard player was great! Only drawback was the waiter service..our waiter was friendly but not very attentive. He took the drink order from half the table and left the other half wondering what happened! But thanks to wonderful waitress Ilene, she came over and explained the menu, made great suggesstions and was extremely acommadating to my picky husband and daughter.

Food is flavorful and tasty, portions are ample. Service is friendly and attentive. Restaurant ambiance vibrant and energetic. Great for romatic dates or family gatherings. We live in the city (definitely worth the drive).

Great place to have brunch. It is not a place for people who eat like a bird; go on an empty stomach as portions are healthy. The Tonno Tartare had just the right amount of seasoning that enhanced the tuna with each bite. If you like lox go for the the really fresh Scottish Salmon, yummy. The Hollandaise sauce on the Eggs Benedict was light and tasty. The eggplant tower must have been made with grandma's sauce. No room for dessert.
The waitstaff was attentive without hovering. We spend several hours - no rush as out.

Took my Fiance and my parents here on a weekday. The food was delicious, everything was full of flavor. The presentation from appetizer to dessert was tantilizing. The staff was very welcoming from the hostess and the manager to the bussers and the server. I was given a tour of banquet halls and both halls were spectacular. This is my first time here but definitely not my last. I would recommend this to all my friends and would consider this a first option for a large group event.

My husband and I had a wonderful dinner. It's a little expensive so we will only be going for special occassions, but can't wait to go back again. The staff was attentive, food terrific and the live music in the lounge was an added bonus.
I went there 2nd time with group of friends.We love it.Everything was perfect.Already schedule a date for next visit.
Sunset dinner was delicious... What a deal! Cant wait to go back and sit outside!

This was not my first time at Vetro and i have to say once again it lived up to my expectations. Food and service were spot on. They even had corned beef as special for St. Patty's day....they really do think of everything. Brunch is next on my list.

Yes the food was wonderful, but we were confused..Having had Valentine's dinner at Vetro last month, we remembered the wonderful and generous sized cocktail we had enjoyed that night..so we ordered 2 more of the same on this visit..we were shocked to see the size of the glass was Half the size we had the last time..What's Up with that?
The staff is incredible the service is excellent, The manager is so cordial.
Tried the 5 course tasting menu each dish was better then the next. The wine list great with alot of half bottles, and priced very reasonably. Service was impeccable from the host to the valet.

Warm and inviting. Nice menu selection, not your typical italian food. Grilled octopus appetizer was tender and grilled to perfection. The lamb chop entree was melt in your mouth tender. Also enjoyed the Pollo alla Romana. Standout desserts. Will definitely go back to try more dishes. Staff and service were excellent, friendly and helpful.
Great place to go with family or friends to have a good food and time.Will go back.
Jean and staff were very attentive without being over bearing..the singer was a nice romantic touch for Valentines Day..very nice experience..Dinner was delish! thanks
The manager always comes over and makes you feel special. The restaurant is excellent
Everything was great, staff was amazing, Thanks again
VERY Italian, lots of music. Dishes are an interesting twist on the traditional. Wonderful wine list, with lots of glasses and half-bottles.
Incredible place, cant wait to go back

I have dined at Vetro several times and absolutely love it. The food is always outstanding, and the atmosphere elegant. I love the decor. Above all, the service is excellent. The waiters are always friendly and attentive. I think that the cooking classes are a great idea and plan to attend the next one. The Sunday brunch and the Sunday and Sunset dinners are priced very attractively. I would recommend Vetro to everyone!!

This was my third business meeting/lunch there this week, so as you can see I like this place alot. They were running a pre-fix lunch special for $20.11 which was perfect for us. Our server Joe was attentive to our every need. I highly recommend this place to everyone.

I was there this week for a business lunch. The lunch menu is great, most starters are $7.50 & entrees are $15.00, you can't go wrong for the type of food & service that they offer. I'm taking another set of clients there Thursday, it's the best place around.

This place is awesome. We did the five course meal for lunch ... never did get around to eating dinner that night. I took my boyfriend here to celebrate our six-month anniversary and Vetro help us to celebrate well. Special recognition to the chef and the live performer.
A special favorite, the Russo family truly knows how to please customers. Excellent, well worth every penny.

They have very nice specials for the early birds! The food is amazing, all 3 courses where incredible! Lobster cappochino-A++++ Salmon was great! The service was unbeatable. Great for a foodie! Will return very soon!
Service- top notch food was great!

What can I say, once again Vetro doesn't disappoint. This was my first visit on a Wednesday & I was in luck because Wednesday's is 1/2 price on all bottles of wine which was an added bonus. We were able to take advantage of some wines we normally haven't been able to splurge on. Our waiter Tommy was great. We will definetly be back again & again.
outstanding dinning. great ambiance.
The restaurant, staff and food were great. I had a very nice time,

If anyone complains about this restaurant --- they probably sit around their kitchen table every night and for Sunday lunch --- with Mama cooking and no one spending a cent! Can't believe it is possible - but Vetro just keeps getting better.

Food was excellent. Cigarette smoke permeating much of our dinner, however. Very disconcerting. Waiter was not as attentive as I wished he had been, despite having no other customers, but was very nice.

Always a great time. It was our first time there for Brunch which was Amazing. Tommy our server was the best. Their brunch menu had endless choices and such an amazing deal. We will def keep recommending Vetro's and will be back as soon as we can!
We are a group of seniors who enjoy eating out on a Saturday night or even any other night. We took advantage of the Sunset Special Dining and it was far beyond our expectations.
Absolutely Amazing! From the ambiance to the bar/lounge to the food -- Impeccable! Better than most top-rated Manhattan restaurants! Do not hesitate for a moment.
Great for that special occasion or for just a great meal. Service is very good

Once again our dining experience at Vetro was outstanding! My guests and I were warmly greeting at the front desk and escorted to the beautiful lounge for some delicious before dinner martini's. Upon being seating we were once again warmly greeted by the waitstaff. Our waitress Eileen remembered our favorite wine selection from our last visit which was quite impressive! Throughout the evening Vetro did not disappoint our out of town visitors, from the signature Lobster cappuccino to the Veal Scallopini and delicious Limoncello Tiramisu and Torrone mousse desserts one thing was better than the next! Cant wait to see what is in store for their next regional tasting!

Beautiful new place. The staff could not have been more helpful. Busy as it was you never felt rushed to finish your meal and get out as other upscale places make you feel. We went for brunch and the menu was good and varied. I had the shrimp dish and highly recommend it!

Went there on Sunday night to celebrate a friends birthday. The food and service where outstanding. The waiters/busboy's were very attentive and friendly. The Sunday Sauce was to die for. Best around Queens. The place itself is gorgeous. Nothing like it around Queens. Will definitely be back and next time we won't wait for a special occasion.

Dinner Sunday evening at Vetro - including live music was amazing. Not many places have put effort in creating an amosphere that is romantic, family friendly, and trendy like this place. The singer was this amazing Italian - young man who was a cross between Michael Buble and Dean Martin - I couldn't believe it. My guests (who's age range was 12-75 years old) all enjoyed the music as well. The food and service were exceptional as usual. The captain was both gracious and knowledgeable - for the first time every - outside of NYC - I allowed the captain to select my wine for me - just offering him the criteria of my taste buds. He seleted a wonderful Shiraz that paired perfectly with the rack of lamb and pasta. Thanks to Mike and Tom.
The food was good, but a limited menu.

I was in today for a business lunch, it was perfect. They gave me a large enough table to enable us to eat & do some paperwork. Teh food was great as usual & the courses were spaced out perfectly. I highly recomend this restaurant to everyone.

Vetro was fantastic. We went with a party of 6 and were promptly seated by a friendly host. The wine list is extensive and the knowledgeable staff helped navigate us through it. Atmosphere was great, they are able to separate the lively bar from the quiet dining area. Our table was checked in on by what I think was the owner a couple of times, great guy. I would highly recommend Vetro for both small and large parties.
Great place to have a nice quite dinner or to celebrate a special occasion.
We had a wonderful time celebrating our anniversary at Vetro. The Lobster Cappuccino was out of this world. The staff was so attentive and courteous. We will be back to check out the bar scene!

Dinner was exceptional. I found the wine list to be very interesting. Was surprised to see the price range. Since their bottle price range was $35-$2500, we actually paired our food w/ 3 different bottles of wine, starting with a half bottle of Gavi di Gavi and moving on to a California Chardonnay and then an Italian Super Tuscan. The food was excellent, the waiter selected most of our dishes, and then kindly coursed them out to 3 separate courses so not to rush us – WAY Rare for a busy restaurant to want to do. Lucky enough for us since it was a client dinner, and I needed to focus on my client rather than the menu. Waiter was professional, but
Great restaurant with excellent service. Will definitely dine there again
Food was great, good service, glad to have a nice restaurant in the neighborhood. It was well needed.

It's a nice place for a special occasion or night out with friends. There is a nice lounge you can wait while your table is being prepared. The service was very friendly and good. They didn't rush the meal and were knowledgeable about the menu and helpful with suggestions. The food was delicious!!! For the feast of Saint Gennaro they had a special small plates/appetizer menu and I had the rice ball, which was one of the best I have ever had. The portions were very generous and the prices were fair. I would definitely go back again and recommend it to others.

It was wonderful. More than met our expectaions. Fabulous food, superb service and beautiful presentaion. The waiter was very helpful in selecting our dinner choices. We will be very happy to try it again. This was our first time.

Vetro by Russo's on the Bay was amazing!!! Service was platinum, food was finger licking good and their rooftop is breathtaking! I took my boyfriend there for a surprise birthday dinner and he was very impressed pleased! They have 2 weeks left until they close their rooftop, so take advantage folks! OVERALL...5 STARS!

We came here shortly after they opened and it was not good. The service was slow and you could tell they were still working though their opening kinks. We dcided to give it another shot and were so glad that we did. The service was wonderful and the food is superb. Russo's restaurants are always great and finally this one is no exception.

As usual an outstanding meal! outstanding service, This has to be one of the best resturants within the 5 boroughs. Five Stars across the board............... Thank you once again for a wonderful evening.
This was the first time my daughter had dinner at Vetro's. It was a wonderful experience. The food was fantastic, the service and the ambiance was great. The service could not have been better.

The Food was unbelievable. The Lobster Ravioli had to be the best I've ever eaten in my entire life. The only problem was the service in the beginning. Waited about 15 minutes before any waiter came over to hand us our menus or take drink orders. Other than that this place is amazing

Having been a patron of Russo's on the bay and villa russo, Vetro met and exceeded my expectations. Dinner was going to be a romanic night but ended up with no baby sitter. The staff was very accomodating toward our two year old. The food was great and so was the view. I look forward to returning for a romantic dinner and would use them for celebrations and business meetings.

Ate Here and it was an amazing experience! The waterside views are quite quaint and romantic. There were Cigars being offered on Monday night. My waiter went the extra mile to celebrate a Birthday within my dining group, and the manager was visible quite often. The ambiance is nice and quiet, not boisterous and loud, so that you can actually hear what people are saying within your group and enjoy your dining experience in peace. The taste and freshness of the food was superb! This is fine dining at it's best!
Excellent Sunday Brunch with family celebrating mother-in-law's birthday! Loved the food, service and ambiance! Beautiful view and thoughtful, friendly, professional waiter!
The food was great!! great views,,service was great..

This was the second time we went back to Vetro for my sons birthday. The food and ambiance and service is better than most New York resturants. We had our grand daughter with us and the staff couldn't have been more welcoming.
Great lunch at Vetro. The outdoor patio with tables was great. If I had a boat, I could have parked it at the restaurant's dock instead of driving in. Food was great and service was impeccable.

Went with a bunch of guys to celebrate a birthday. Our waiter, Tommy, who I know from previous dining experiences at Vetro, actually remembered what is my drink of preference. He took good care of us though out the meal. The food was extraordinary; I had the best swordfish of my life; flavorful with garlic and not at all fishy-tasting and cooked to perfection. Appetizers of baked clams and calamari were excellent as well. The restaurant at dinnertime is quite a different experience from the more subdued lunch patrons. The atmosphere was vibrant but certainly not over the top. I cannot wait for my next Vetro dining experience.

My husband and his friends enjoyed a great lunch experience. My husband and I have had dinner many times at this wonderful restaurant and so he wished to share a great eating place with his pals who love to eat.

I picked this place for a girls-only birthday lunch. All of us are absolutely in love with this place now. The staff was very accommodating and non-intrusive. The food was very pretty and delicious. The drinks were great. The view from their outdoor patio onto the canal is awesome. It was just a perfect birthday. Oh, make sure to check out their lounge - it's gorgeous.
After dinner we went up to the rooftop lounge which was very nice. the weather was perfect the atmosphere was relaxing listening to Frank Sinatra. Never would imagine you were still in Queens.
Dinner was delicous. Service was very good. They aim to please.

I have to say the atmosphere, the service and especially the food, was fantastic. I can't wait to go back... we went for a simple sunday brunch and ended up having a delicous lunch with cocktails.. we could have sat there for hours.... Great find !

Everything was wonderful as usual. I got rave reviews from my girlfriend's family who usually don't like going out to eat, but they loved everything about the place. Afterwards we went upstairs to their new rooftop lounge for drinks, this place is amazing.
We had an overall wonderful evening at Vetro. The meal presentation and quality, dining ambiance and service all contributed to an unforgettable time.

My wife and I were recommended to dine at Vetro. Our experience was very pleasant. The food was excellent as well as the service. I would recommend this restaurant to all my friends and family to visit for a nice relaxing evening free of everyday stress. From the Lobster salad, to the tender Lamb Chops and finishing off the meal with a trio of sorbet and a after dinner drink we left the restaurant vowing to return. Our server Louis was very helpful in helping us to select the perfect meal. Overlooking our table was Jamiie who brought a ray of sunshine and smiles to us through out our meal.

This restaurant has become one of my favorites.  The food is amazing, the decor lovely, it has water views and just to go above and beyond it has entertainment!  What more can you ask for?  We tend to go for special occasions or when they have special offers though because it can be pricey.

Finally with the summer right around the corner I was able to take part in the outdoor dining on the water. The food, service & ambiance was great as usual but the outdoor elememt puts it over the top. I'm even more excited to find out that they're opening a rooftop lounge in July. This place has it all, you gotta check it out.
What a great place for lunch. We sat on the patio and enjoyed great food and a beautiful view.
This place is great. Best crab cakes I ever had! We all tried items from their Regions menu, each one was better than the next. Stellar service. Definately a new favorite. Will be back

Everything was excellent, as always. Jamie was very attentive and we loved the drinks that Noel made. He's the best bartender...just to even stop by the lounge area and say hello. And they had a great jazz singer there as well.
Food was outstanding! I would RUN back.

The service staff was excellent and attentive. They were friendly yet very professional. The food was very good and the presentation was excellent. The only drawback is that the noise level in the dining room is not very conducive to table conversation. There should be more sound absorbing materials added to make dining at Vetro a truly wonderful experience.
Had a great time. Excellent place. Staff was very helpful and attentative.

First "Brunch" experience at Vetro - superb! We invited friends who frequent many top Manhattan restaurants, and whose son is a chef -- they were quite impressed. Never a disappointment - always a wonderful experience.

Unfortunately we were very disappointed and would not be going back again. Although they seemed well staffed, many were not familar with the menus and the service was TERRIBLE! We were brought out the wrong appetizers and had to wait for our main course for way over 1 hour. This was happening with other tables around us as well. The food was decent, but I have had much better for a much more reasonable price. Very overpriced and not worth it at all!
The food was excellent. Great place for special occassions.
Very good food and very competent service. Pricey but worth it. Great crabcakes

I really wanted to love this place! I mean it is owned by Russo's and I was expecting it to be up to par with Russo's. It fell short. Let's start off with the positives... The ambiance is wonderful. The captian was very imformative in regards to the menu. Now for the not so positives... The food was a bit well done. FOr instance the breading on the baked clams could have been called burned as was the pastry crust of the chicken dish I had as my main course. The dessert course was a bit of a comedy show. They have something, then they don't have it or they don't have it then they do. Come on people figure out what you ran out of and inform the customers correctly. A bit disappointing to say the least!

the food was excellent we were a table of 5 and without execption all raved about the quality and taste of the food.The lone exception to being a top restaurant was the fact that piped music was on during dinner. At our requesat it was turned down but not off great food does not need a music accompnient.

This was our fifth time dining at Vetro's. The service from the Bartenders, General Manager PJ and waiters was outstanding. The food was outstanding as usual but I must say we both had surf and turf and the steak was as good as or better than any New York Steak House. I strongly recommend it. Vetro's has become one of our faviorite restaurants.

Great, great, great is all I can say. I have eaten dinner here many times but this was our first time for lunch. The food & service was awsome as usual & the lunch prices were moderate. I highly recomend this place to everyone, if you havent tried it. GO!

This was our 4th visit to Vetro -- it's hard to believe -- but it just keeps getting better. The bartender in the lounge (Noel) was an added plus to the evening. Going back the end of May for brunch - and can't wait!
Dining at Vetro's was a most enjoyable experience. Everything was just great....
The Russo family has another gem!!!

An amazing menu for wine and specialty drinks. Dinner menu was fantastic with different styles to accompany anyone’s taste. I tried the creative lobster cappuccino appetizer and I never had anything so delicious. Overall the menu was creative with different flares on some traditional dishes. You can’t beat the ambiance that Vetro brings to a night out for any occasion. Loved it!
A truly excellent restaurant in all ways. Very innovative menu and fabulous pastry chief.
Outstanding dining experience. Creative, eclectic menu and wonderful ambience. Beautiful lounge for pre-dinner drinks. The food was exceptional.

The food, service , ambiance was beyond our expectations. There was not a crumb left on our plates for any of the courses. The veal chop is a must have and the suckling pig was excellant. The prices were very reasonable for the quality of the food. It is a must go to in the tri-state area.
A wonderful destination for that special occasion. The excellent service was only outdone by the excellent quality of the food. An upscale gem.

Vetro Restaurant and Lounge clearly surpasses every culinary expectation anyone may have before dining. Our group of 8 spent an hour prior to our reservation in Vetro's beautifully decorated lounge for cocktails. Enough cant be said about the ambiance as we caught up in a comfortable setting.
Dinner itself couldn't have been better, as our captain Mario guided us through Vetro's expansive wine list, and Chef DeGeorgio's creative regional menu. The food was out of this world.
Whether you have a special occasion coming up, or just want to have a great night out, Vetro by Russo's on the Bay will provide memories for a lifetime.

We celebrated our 36th anniversary at Vetro last friday night. We were impressed with the ambiance of the place and the service. Our waiter attended to us and made sure that we were pleased with everything. Jamie, the maitre d was very pleasant and also attentive to us. The food was superb and pleasant to the eye also. It truly is a gem in our neighborhood. We will definitely return....
Went for a small birthday party. The service was fantastic as was the food. Very nice cocktail and wine list. I would most certainly return.

From the Valet to the Captain - I have not experienced better personnel. The lounge for drinks is a beautiful touch - great to have your drink in this room and then head to your table. This is our second visit to Vetro - and certainly will not be our last. I base a restaurant on their baked clams - and I'm pleased to say - they were as good as Don Peppe's and Parkside!
Went there last night for my birthday, with my fiancee. Food was amazing. Hands down a new favorite. You will not be dissappointed.

As usual the service and food was outstanding. I highly recommend this resturant to anyone who wishes sample food from different regions in Italy. I have visited this resturant many times and have never been disappointed.

This was my second time here and we had a great time. The service & food were top-notch. The decor is beautiful and upscale, although since it's owned by Russo's, I expected nothing less. I'm looking forward to the outdoor experience as well. Good luck.

This was our first time here and it was top-notch. It's owned by Russo's on the Bay so I expected nothing less. The decor is gorgeous, the service was professional and very attentive and the food was fresh and delicious. They have a great wine list and the lounge area is excellent for a before or after-dinner cocktail or even if you want to stop in for drinks. Noel is a great bartender!!

My husband and I had the pleasure of dining at Vetro this week. From the moment you enter you are greeted with the most pleasant and attentive staff. We started our evening with a cocktail in the beautifully decorated lounge, we were then escorted to our table. Our waiter Charles was very happy to answer any questions and gave us great wine recommendations from their extensive list. Everything we had was absolutely delicious and the presentation was amazing. The manager PJ came by several times to make sure we were enjoying our dinner. Vetro is not you run of the mill Italian food you MUST try for a truly fine dining experience!
Excellent service and very personable staff

What can I say but it was a perfect evening. We started with a cocktail in the lounge (which is beautiful) and were seated promptly to our table which had a great view. Charles took care of us and explained the menu well. We both tried the tasting menu and loved it. The food was amazing and the desert was unbelievable. A wine suggested to compliment the meal is now my husbands favorite. The entire staff was attentive and I will be telling everyone in the neighborhood it is a MUST. I was told they are starting Brunch on Sunday so we will be there to check it out.

Celebrated Valentine's day with my girlfriend and had a great experience. Very nice place with good service to enjoy a special evening, and the food was excellent! Would definitely recommend the lobster cappucino for an appetizer. For dinner we had the halibut and filet mignon. Both were delicious and cooked perfectly. Also highly recommends the sweet potato side dish with your dinner!! Would definitely go back.

terrific experience. not your everyday neighborhood restaurant. a little expensive for a neighborhood restaurant but the food was out of this world. great place for a romantic dinner but not for the entire family.

This was my second time to the restaurant, first time with my wife and this last time with business people. The decor is great, very spacious between tables, easy parking and not waiting long for your car. The bar area is also spaceious and a very nice place to meet for a drink before dinner or just to go for cocktails. This is another great place opened by the Russo Family.

Once again the management staff of Russo's on the bay hits the high mark with yet another gem. Vetro doesn't have daily specials, instead they're regional menu which changes every 2 weeks features a different area of Italy, we decided to have the complete 5 course tasting, every course was better than the next. Off of the regular menu I recommend the baked clams, sea bass or veal chop with pistachios. If your indecisive leave it up to the chef & he'll put together a meal second to none. If you haven't been there you have to try it.

The service was impeccable. The food was delicious. The only thing I was disappointed with was the Napoleon for dessert. Not what I expected. I was expecting a cake size portion. The presentation was beautiful for all the food and the dessert. I was just expecting a different type of cake.

The place is absolutely beautiful. The food was superb! The service was warm, friendly, and knowledgeable. EXCELLENT wine list, very well put together. It is such a pleasure to find a place with such a City flare without having to drive to NYC & deal with traffic & parking. The lounge was a perfect place to have a drink before sitting to dinner. This place will be a BIG HIT in the warm weather. The view is spectacular from their outside seating.Can't wait!

Once again I enjoyed a great meal, each time I go there I try a new dish. The baked clams & the polenta were so good. I had the Chilean sea bass as my entre & My friend had the veal with pistachios everything was great. I recomend the sweet potatoes as a side dish & be sure to save room for dessert!

The food was delicious and the staff was friendly but, the service for the price and the hype was completely lacking. We waited close to 45 minutes to get our first drink and place our food order. The second round after approx. 20 minutes had to be summoned by another staff member. The wait between appetizer to entree was too long and my final drink, which I ordered prior to the entree arriving, never came. For the price I've been to much better.
The food is the best, service is unbelievable and the atmosphere terrific.

What a wonderful dining experience. As soon as you step foot into the place, you forget that your still in queens. The staff was friendly and accommodating. They paid attention to every detail. The food was off the charts! The wine list is very impressive. If you love wine, this is the place for you. After dinner we had drinks in the gorgeous lounge. Great from start to finish. I can't wait to go back.

Vetro was an elegant dining experience with amazing food. Whatever ingredients the chef decided to use in his creations complimented all other ingredients perfectly. Each bite of my meal was just amazingly delicious. From the complimentary bread to the diverse desserts, Vetro was a great tasting dinner experience.
Service was also impeccable, and very friendly.

The only downside is the following... Vetro is a little pricey, but it's understandable given how great the food is. Also, I feel that with a restaurant like Vetro, presentation and taste are number one. Because of that Vetro does not give you the most ample amounts of food.
All in all Vetro is a must for food lovers looking for a taste sensation like no other.

Once again, Vetro was an outstanding dining experience. From the moment we arrived, the service was impeccable! This was our third time back and we chose the Ligurian 5 course tasting menu. It was delicious, we can't wait to go back and see what the chef creates for the rest of Italy's regions! Our waiter chose some wonderful wines to compliment our meal from their extensive, wine list. Our evening was made complete with after dinner drinks in the exquisitely decorated lounge.
This was the most enjoyable dining experience I have had in many years. My friend and I plan on dining here at least once a month!

Absolutely fabulous! Everything was impeccable. The Lobster Ravioli was the best I have tasted. Service was incredible. They were completely attentive but not obtrusive. Finally, the food was divine. One improvement can be made- the Caesar Salad. I do not care for vinegar in my Caesar Salad. Overall, everything was prepared and presented beautifully. I enjoyed my dining experience thoroughly and cannot wait to return.

The service was superb. The food was delicious and the ambiance was magnificent. Had a wonderful dinner and a drink at the bar afterwards. Everyone was personal, friendly and very attentive to all your needs. Great evening was had by all!

Allow me to introduce myself, I am "Ms. Fussy", a name my husband has given me regarding my dining experiences. If you are like me, Please, go to Vetro. You will not be disappointed. The food, atmosphere and attention by the wait staff were outstanding. There was a mellow, guitarist there who added to our enjoyment. I was told he is there on Thursdays. The dining room was decorated with an eye for detail. The Merano Glass ceiling sculpture brought to life by the subtle changing colored lights. The dining room was romantically dark and I had a little trouble reading the menu. The waiter gave me a penlight to use,without my asking. Love mind reading wait staff. The food? Nothing short of exquisite. I was greatly impressed. I will return soon.
ARE YOU KIDDING!!!!! Without a doubt the best dining experience ever!!!!
From meeting the parking attendant to the entire staff inside - this was a very wonderful dining experience.
Finally, I no longer have to go to Manhattan to have a great dining experience. Well done guys. I will definitely be back once a week.

I can not say how great this resturant was from the moment you enter until you leave. I have eaten in many resturants but this resturant is on the top of my list. The service was outstanding. Everyone was very attentive to every need and request. The menu was different not the run of the mill Italian menu. Every item ordered melted in your mouth. I would not hesitate to recommend this resturant to anyone who wants to be treated extra special and have an outstanding meal.

Vetro's is perfect if you're looking for that special place to go for a romantic evening. The staff is personal, giving recommendations and caring for special requests for the evening. It's a relaxing atmosphere, and beautiful. The food is amazing as well, very european and the wine list is breathtaking, with over 300 wines to choose from...you're sure to find one that compliments your meal. Buon appetite!
negative: Everything took forever. Menus came out 15min after being seated. Bread came out about 20-25min after menus. Drinks took about 30min or more. Food took over an hour. Even the check took long to get to us after requesting it. They definitely seem understaffed or need better time management. Server was friendly but unfortunately, the excess waiting times for literally everything took the entire enjoyment away therefore we did not have a good experience. I wouldn't recommend
The place is outdated, the service was poor. They served a steak which was raw inside.  The food was overpriced. We will not be coming back.

Unfortunately which is becoming the norm, the restaurant did not hold up to their attire requirements.  Patrons wearing ball caps, t-shirts etc. Felt like I was a a mid scale restaurant. When I spend over $700 for the meal for 3 guest I would have expect much better. Food was good wine was exceptional.
The food was good but in small portions,  We left there hungry and went to the diner
Only negative Arrived early Place empty Seated us facing a wall I should have said something

We were not impressed this time around. We sat down and it took a while for someone to come over and start us off with drinks. We finally got drinks, which were great. We order the cheese board. It was very small from the last time we order it and the fritto misto had a few pieces. I didn’t see any shrimp or scallops. What a bummer. I order the pork saltbacca. It was okay. It was two small pieces of small and had a strange after taste. The mash potatoes were good. The fried pork chop we also ordered didn’t come with any starches or vegetables. Maybe everything was small because there was a lot of private parties going on. We ordered dessert which was okay. We had the pistachio tartufo, cappuccino, and a double espresso. We ordered lemoncello. I have to be honest I was very hungry after we left and was not impressed at all. The last time we were there it was amazing. Better luck next time.
Service was not good.  They were very busy and had to wait very long for water, bread. , menus.  Had the steak it was just fair.  I make much better at home.   Food was just ok. Will not return
Too many servers checking in on you too often. Overall very aggressive, kind of off putting when trying to enjoy what was otherwise a nice meal. Advice to management, slow it down some

We were seated in the back room where it was cold. The room was not heated as yet. We were told that the doors were open earlier for a party. They should have turned on the heat after the doors were closed.
The cook served us a spoiled fish. As you can understand I am not very happy and I can't give a good review.
With a name that includes Russo’s on the Bay, you would think that it would be above par…..not so!

We started with the baked clams, which quite frankly were mediocre. They were not piping hot as one would expect if cooked properly and broiled to a sizzling top crisp just before serving - instead they were warm and somewhat mushy.
The service was non existent, and we waited forever to get a check and even longer to check out. I felt like I had checked in to Hotel California.
Needless to say I will never return.

The host gives you her choice of table I had requested edge of water under reservation and she gave me a table of her choice and gave me an excuse is for 6ppl or more  yet another family of 4 came and requested a table by the water and she said you have to request online under reservation I wanted to tell her oh yes what happened to us but I was among friends I havent seen in a while and wanted to be happy I let it pass.  It was the indian girl.

I must say we were seated fast, the ambiance and food was amazing  but the service was very slow. We were passed  several times for about 45 minutes before anyone besides the set up guy came to pour our water. There were people who came in and even were seated after us that received appetizers before we did.  They can claim it was busy if they like but for me attention at least to ask how we are doing while we wait is important . I tried it once and probably will not go back but if you want a great pork chop (that’s all that’s served with it)

Drove an hour from Long Island to meet friends from upstate. We picked this restaurant based on recommendations. We were sat out on a cold deck with what seem to be patio furniture. My husband‘s food was cold and our friends son got raw chicken. Very raw!  They did a great job of connecting the problem and even offered free dessert. Still would not go back.
Do not order a White Russian with Absolute, it cost an absurd $23.  Otherwise everything else was fine
The food was good, the place was just extremely cold.

Was denied 7PM reservation yet restaurant was virtually EMPTY during the 7 - 9PM timeframe!! Portions were rediculously small.  Left hungry and stopped for pizza on the way home.  Been to Vetro 50 times but no more.  Stop into Bruno's down the road to see how portions should be presented
Went here for the convenience of other travelers. Not a favorite for a non local restaurant.
The slowest service I have ever received. Took 10mins for the waiter to bring me salt. Food took forever to come out.

I was trying to surprise my girlfriend but the hostess blurted out that we were a party of 4 and our other guest was already waiting in the lounge - contrary to the specific instructions when I spoke to the hostess over the phone earlier today regarding seating our earlier guest and that our last guest was going to arrive later on.
Service was extremely slow. We had to wait a very long time for drinks, appetizers, meal and even check.

They had a party there the same time as us.  They ignored our table for 30 minutes at a time.  The got orders wrong.  Just a mess.  Also prob the worst thing you can say about an Italian restaurant...the bread was supermarket quality
The food was subpar at best. I was highly disappointed as I have been there before and was so impressed. This was not that experience.

Absolutely disgraceful that they take no pride in their image. Because of no dress requirement 4 poorly dressed guys in t-shirts, sweatshirts, jeans and sneakers were seated in the main dining area. As well as some others. They were dressed for a bowling alley. The portions were small, prices too high and drinks way too expensive. This is Queens, not Manhattan. Servers seem to be quick to clean up. Ridiculous, that waiters were dressed in suits but expected less in appearance from their customers.  Also, a very limited menu. For the size of the place the bathrooms very limited in quantity and poorly placed in the dining area. Only 2 unisex bathrooms, really?

We waited 45 minutes for our table, which wasn’t that big of a deal, since it was Christmas Eve.once seated we waited about 15-20 minutes for our drink order to be taken. Then had the waiter talk us out of ordering the items we wanted because it would be “too much food”. Then waited another 40 minutes for antipasto to be served and within 2 minutes of that being set on our table, our entrees arrived. We felt incredibly rushed and somehow forgotten about at the same time.

This is the second time we’ve had issues with service here, once before on Mother’s Day, but we wanted to give it another chance being a staple in the community. We won’t be giving it another chance, though.

The only levels you give for noise as being loud is energetic. It was unruly there was a table that the  restaurant staff did nothing about that was so loud some of there own party was trying to quiet them down. Very unpleasant!

From reading some of these reviews, I’m not sure I was in the same restaurant.  The restaurant is beautiful, intimate, quiet, and the perfect atmosphere for a date night.  The service people are neat, polite and friendly. The food is completely average and I think that’s a generous assertion.  Our waiter was only present to take our order and we didn’t see him again until the end of the meal.  Several times we needed one thing or another and had to ask the hostess to notify the waiter and still someone else brought out the item (not the waiter).  We ordered from the restaurant week menu.  My friend and I ordered the mussels as an appetizer.  The portion was on the small side and the mussels very very average.  We both agreed it was just ok. My other friend ordered the mozzarella and tomatoes...not bad.  Two of us ordered skirt steak.  Generous portion but over marinated and not the best skirt steak I’ve had and topped with the greasiest thin onion strings I’ve ever seen.  It also came with a few pieces of roasted potatoes and a dollop of spinach, both were fine but I’m sorry to say my local diner has a heartier, tastier skirt steak.  For dessert they only offer one choice: the raspberry sorbet.  This was delicious and may have been the best part of the meal.  The bread was not hot and fresh.  I was glad about that because when the bread is good I’m tempted to have an extra piece...carb overload. The bottom line:  If you’re looking for a cozy spot with great ambience, friendly service (when you can find them) Vetro is for you.  If you’re looking for great food, standby I’ll come up with some much better places.
Appetizers were very small portions. Waited a long time for main course. No Choice for desert. Restaurant week menu was limited.
