It would have been perfect if we could have eliminated the biting annoying insects from the area. I took most of my dinner home. I could not eat and swat. I ate there before but we ate indoors. I guess that would be my other option
Everything was great, however, one caution to everyone, apparently they do not have high chairs or booster seats for children.  They require you to bring your Childs stroller into the restaurant.
Was told too windy to sit outside. Should that not be the patrons decision? Calamari was not up to par
Have eaten at Vetro many times and enjoyed it.This time was different the service was very poor.We won't be back for awhile.
Food isn't what it used to be , I wouldn't ho back

Our waiter must not eat at Russos because the items he recommended were not very good at all. They even ran out of the opera trio cake at 6pm? The whole evening was substandard. We go to Russos to eat very often. It made me wonder if they changed chefs and the servers. We may not go back after this which breaks my heart because i have been going here for years.
Service was weak. I had lamb chops. Not good - overcooked. Calamari was fair. Even the tartufo was only fair. Will not be coming back. Total waste of an evening. Food at Lenny's Clam Bar is better!
The temperature in the restaurant was freezing ,  we were so cold we couldn't wait to leave.

We usually love this place. However, we've always gone there for lunch and, because this was a special 50th anniversary celebration, we decided,on dinner. The service was appallingly slow waited almost 1/2 hour for our drinks. My dinner was listed,under,appetizers, but the waiter assured me it would be available as a dinner selection as well. Yes, the charge was doubled for dinner, but the size was definitely not a dinner portion. I,ordered a glass of white wine which came in a small carafe with something floating in it. It was replaced but not a word of apology. At almost $100 per person, it was not, not, not worth the cost.

Been here several times before, and always rated it excellent, but was disappointed this time. First, outdoor dining area was closed -- on one of the nicest evenings this summer! No reason given, so we were stuck in the gaudy and over decorated main dining room. Large party with undisciplined children seemed to occupy waiters' attention, so it was some time before waiter got to us and he wanted our drink and dinner order together.  (Usually drink order comes first!) Our harried waiter didn't even read us the specials, though the table next to ours got a full recitation. Food -- both my wife's pasta and my seafood -- was curiously over salted. (We'd had these same entrees before and they were much better.) Restaurant wasn't that crowded but waiters and servers seemed stressed. Took some time to get the bill (again, because of large birthday party going on). Suggestions: Open outdoor area on nice days! Hire more staff if you have to! Tell chefs to go easier on the salt! I will definitely give Vetro another try and hope that these problems were anomalous. I used to love this place!!

The taste and the presentation of the dishes were good. Portions are rather small. What killed it - intervals between courses were 1 hour!! Not like we were in rush, but it was a bit extensive. We arrived on time for our reservation, and even though there were only few people sitting outside, we were told that we had to wait because "it was very busy outside". That's ok. Drinks were a bit watered down. We spent 3 hours for an absolutely regular, nothing extraordinary dinner. We liked it but probably won't come back.

I lived in Howard Beach all of my life & have been to Russo's many times as well as Vetro. Service was NOT as it used to be at Vetro. Very scattered & unorganized; seriously disappointed. Was going to have our engagement party there--now we are 're-thinking that idea.

Well for a brunch there was one basket of mini bagels and some store bought danish. We had to ask for butter twice and the waiter forgot my diet coke.  My mom and I had the eggplant parm which was horrible and I asked desert was poor as well. I would never recommend this restaurant to anyone.
Not happy with my dinner. I request for a candle lights dessert for my boyfriend for his birthday noting happen and it's his first birthday we were celebrating and I am very upset it didn't happen.
after waiting for our bottle of wine for 45 minutes, which didn't arrive, we left. the bread and breadsticks were stale. horrible waiter and service.
Wasn't impressed by it and it was quite evident they cater to local high end customers in different rooms that they put other patrons This regular room was virtually empty Food ok but not great
Food was good but not for the price
This place is highly over rated and over priced.
FIVE MEN DINING, THREE COMPLAINED THAT THE VALDOSTANA WAS TOO SALTY.  SERVICDE VERY SLOW.

Really , microscopic $52 steaks !!!! Come on Russo family , this is no celebrity midtown manhattan establishment ! We were seated at 830 and dinner didn't arrive till 1030pm , ridiculous and unacceptable . The staff was apologetic but the free after dinner drinks didn't erase the fact that our bill was over $400 and we has to wait so long to eat . The decor is beautiful but definitely not worth my time and money!

Went with my husband for our anniversary. This was our third visit there and was very disappointed with the food. Caesar salad was not cold and was wilty. Fried calamari was a plate full of tentacles, very few rings. Stuffed shrimp was EXTREMELY salty, and I am a person who doesn't mind salt but this was overpowering. I told the waiter about it and he said he has heard that complaint before. So, why don 't they make it less salty?? Also, the room was uncomfortably hot and humid.  Asked three times for some air conditioning before we got a little relief. Previous visits were nice, except for the horrible lobster mac and cheese which is still on their menu. Needs attention to the food or we will not be going back. We will go to Matteo's of HB
the service was excellent but the food wasn't what i thought it would be like for this type of place. Tasted like a regualre italian restaurant but allot more expensive.

We went to the rooftop bar after a lovely dinner in the restaurant and what a disappointment. The drinks were served in flimsy plastic cups, there were no barstools, and the bartender told us that there was a $200 minimum to sit at a table.  Seriously, serving $10 glasses of wine in plastic cups??  Really tacky, especially after the elegance of the restaurant.

They don't carter to children and waited 45 minutes to be seated. I had made reservation for 8:30pm. It is a nice place but over priced for this neighborhood.  If I am going to pay for manhattan prices then I would go into the city to eat and enjoy the food. The only reason I went because I live in the neighborhood.

Brunch was ok. Not kid friendly or a kids menu. My table did not have an umbrella although I asked for one. They could not accommodate us even though tables with umbrellas became available. So we had to sit in the hot burning noon sun for our entire meal. My 7 year old was not happy and I had to get up from my table and stand in shade.

I was disappointed at the end. Our server brought the check, and he wrote the suggested tip amount. After the server processed the payment, he filled in the tip line with the suggested amount. If it is a business practice, or if we were being judged, it was a turn off after such a wonderful meal. I tipped appropriately, more than what was suggested but less than what I had planned.

We waited 45 minutes in lounge with a confirmed reservation. Then sat another 11/2 hours before our dinner was served. They blamed everybody but them selves for the delay and we only ordered chicken. Never again.

Beautiful outside and location but dining room is like being in a basement . Our waiter was rude and once he took out order didn't as much as make eye contact after. My husband had to grab his arm to stop him to get more drinks. I heard amazing things about the food but I couldn't even eat my "pork osso buco" , which is one of my favorite dishes. I couldn't get the meat off the bone even with a knife! Our waiter was overly attentive and friendly with the third couple that came in after us, so I guess if your not a regular you don't count. I will never find out bc I will not return .

At dinner we had a waiter who had a bit of an attitude. He said the specials and my wife missed a couple and asked him if he could say them over again and he said "I thought you said can I rollover again" and looked at her strange. Not funny at all and needless to say I was less than happy. Did not say anything because it was our friends birthday but very inappropriate and uncalled for.

Sat at the bar for a cocktail well before our scheduled dinner. We ordered 2 simple drinks a pinot and a Stoli Club. The bartender poured a finger of Pinot from an empty bottle into a glass, then opened a new bottle and poured more into the same glass. This is a classy place - not. Then poured a stoli over ice w/a splash of soda. proceeded to tell how great of a mixologist he is. Then begins to tell us that he was hit by a car on three separate occassions and survived. He continues by saying he is a mixed-martial artist and has been fighting for 28 years even though he is only 34. CRAZY! Tried an app of Mozz and Pros - it was horrible but the bartender defended it even though he didn't know what was supossed to be in it. So we left.

appetizes was pricey and very little for the price you pay the could of gave alittle more on them we ordered 3 appetizes..the fried Calamari was tasty but we were lucky and not joke if there were 20 calamari on the plate they would of been alot ..we also had the baked clams very good but very small clams hardly any meat they were so small..then the mazzorala for 4 people they cut it in half we were lucky we got a fork full..come on you could give more appetizes for the money...but I do have the say the dinners were very good and very tasty..drinks very expensive..4 glassas of scotch on the rocks..$42 come on could of bought a bottle...would I return yes maybe but just straight dinner no appetizes and def not drinks..sorry..

The food was good lthough quite expensive. It was so noisy that I could barely hear my husband even though he spoke in an elevated tone. The acoustics were terrible so it was difficult to enjoy the meal. We were happy to leave.

Not a great experience at a birthday brunch celebration. The service was terrible, parts of the entree were forgotten, an incorrect entree was brought to the table before they realized it was incorrect, we waited forever for the right meal to be delivered while the rest of the group's food got cold. The waiters forgot to bring things thy we asked for, like butter for my mom's pancakes and then tried to take our coffee order twice. The food was average at best and on the pricey side.

Was very excited to finally be able to try vetro but the excitement was shot down as soon as I sat at the bar. While I was waiting for my table I ordered a mojito he asked me "do i really have to have that?" and listened to him complain that he had to make one. Once we started to eat the appetizers were excellent but were not impressed with the main course. Although the portions of food were tremendous the quality was not as equally impressive. Was also suprised to see no one coming around to offer fresh black pepper or grated cheese. When dessert was served coffee was only warm and one of the desserts were completely inedible. Maybe should have just had the appetizers and drinks on the rooftop and enjoyed the atmosphere.

i made a reservation and was told my table would be ready in a few minutes. over an hour later i had to speak to the hostess bc a couple thay walked in after me was seated before me. at that time because i threatened to leave she sat us. i was very dissappointed. probbly will not return.
Much too noisy to enjoy our meal.

I went to a wedding at Vetro's just a month ago and I found that the food at the wedding pretty much replicated what was served at the affair. The room was noisy and I felt that the waiters did not know what they were doing. I asked for a vodka martini straight up with olives to the waiter and I got a barmaid to serve me the martini minus the olives. When I asked where were the olives, she said ,"oh, you ordered olives? , I'll come back" Well ten minutes passed when I finally got my olives served by a bus boy. Then I received the wrong entree. The maitre'd just happened tn come to the table at the time that I noticed the error and he immediately went back to the kitchen and had the correct entree served.

Horrible experience, food was ok but service was awful. Waitress never told us about specials and we were there at 7:30 and it was not all that crowded so she certainly wasn't that busy. When we ordered our entrees, she said it would be about 25-30 minutes Long wait between courses and when coffee came, had to be sent back because it must have been the end of the pot as it tasted terrible Then when it came it was decaf which nobody requested. Very disappointed, I had looked at all the reviews and it sounded so good but never experienced such bad service.
The worst service I have ever had in my life. Food wasn't good enough to make up for it.

I think it's highly overrated, knowing that this is a satellite to Russo's on the Bay it falls remarkably short of the standard I would have expected. I was on time for my reservation and saw tables available but, of course they want you to sit and have a drink in the lounge first. When I was finally seated it took almost an hour to get my appetizer. I believe in not being rushed and enjoying the whole dining experience but, just not worth all the hype and money. I will not be back.

This was the 4th time we were there. The first 3 times the food and service was excellent. This time the food again was excellent but the service was terrible. It started with having a drink in the lounge which we alway have but this time it was over crowded with people (not drinking) just waiting to go upstairs. We were told by the maitre d that our table was ready and when we went in the dining room he realized it wasn't and had us wait in hallway. We brought guests with us and were totally embarrassed. No one came and apologized. We were never even offered a complimentary cup of coffee or after dinner drink.

It's hard to believe anyone really liked the food. La Villa in Lindenwood is far superior for food. The music at Vetro was totally inappropriate for relaxed, pleasant dining. It was so dark I couldn't read the menu. I won't return.
neutral: It was my first time there and a first date and it was perfect.  The food was incredible and the service was perfect!
Brunch with Santa

I would definitely recommend Vetro. The service was amazing . The waiter was very helpful and attentive. Everything was delicious. I had the salmon and my husband had shrimp santino.  We enjoyed the mini cannolis for dessert. They gave us a card and put confetti on our table for our anniversary celebration. If you want to celebrate any special occasion, this is a beautiful restaurant.
we always say the same thing when we leave.......we should come here more frquently
We had a wonderful dinner outside on the patio. The weather was perfect and the moon gleaning on the bay was amazing.
Amazing!!!!

We took a friend her for his birthday lunch.  Vetro couldn't have been nicer or more accommodating.  It was windy outside so we asked to be moved inside.  No problem.  There was a birthday card from Vetro staff at our guest's seat, along with birthday confetti.  What a nice touch that was.  When dessert came, they had a sparkler in the dessert and staff sang Happy Birthday.  So special!
10 year Anniversary
Great restaurant!!
We tried 3 different cocktails: TRUE MOSCOW MULE,
Good food but what do you expect it’s Russo’s only the best !
Very good!
Always excellent in service and food
There are only 2 words for this restaurant "THE BEST"
Thank you Pur
What was efficient; the valet parking.  A ticket wasn't even required;  my vehicle was out in front when I exited the restaurant and attendant immediately drove it up.
A little over priced for the lobster
Great as always!
All was fine, although I would have been happier without the live music.  It was loud and interfered with conversation.

Ambiance is great, it's right by the water. There was a party going on upstairs, but we sat outside since it was a nice day. We both had Filet Mignon just plain without sauce and also wine recommended by waiter. He chose well and served us promptly. The filet was a nice thick cut. I haven't seen this size usually. We ordered medium, but the center was definitely rare. This took away from it a bit, but the outside was prepared just right. Service was good, with the manager checking in on us 4 times.
Thank You again Vetro.  Hope to see you soon.

I had to skirt steak  which I only took two bites out of since there was a  lemon Taste to it,  I agree that it's a taste preference however I wouldn't have wanted it had I seen lemon anywhere in the description.  The meat itself was cooked to a perfect medium well as I requested.
look forward to my next visit there and we can get my in-laws to watch the kids :-)
It's not an inexpensive place to dine and I don't know if it's worth it.
Our favorite restaurant!😀
However if you are on a budget, this may not be the place to attend.
The salmon on the Prix Fix menu was excellent but I felt the Caesar Salad left something to be desired.  Our server was excellent and very attentive as was the Hostess.

Everything about Vetro is 5 stars! It's my favorite restaurant. I go there "just to go" and also for special occasions. They never disappoint. Food, wine, service, atmosphere, all great! Highly recommend. Olivia, our waitress, excellent! Don't ever lose that one :-)
Our favorite restaurant!!!😀
To go back again would be hard. You can get the same meal with the same service anyplace in NYC.

Yes, I am starting with the valet because from this first encounter with Mr. Russo's staff, the hospitality of the Vetro employee's begins! The front door is then opened for the start of your evening by the courteous doorman.  The hosts begin the evening with warm greetings (after a few times there hugs and kisses!), Teal takes extraordinary care of us and pays attention to details. The bar area is gorgeous with its blue decor and wide variety of well made drinks (love the peach mango martini). Brian was our Captain for the evening-he is on top of his game, he will always steer you right in suggesting certain dinner items, he is polite & knowledgable & makes you feel like family. Trust PJ the sommelier to pick your wine for dinner--he always comes up with a winner and will keep it in your price range.  Oh yes, the food is terrific.  The baked clams are great as is the tuna tartare or the calamari. Our guests also loved their main courses including the veal chop, shrimp with crabmeat and I had lobster fra diavolo over linguine-all were delicious!! Save room for dessert, definitely try the opera cake, the cheesecake or the rice pudding. Our friends now understand why we travel an hour and a half to have dinner at Vetro! Frank Russo also must be proud of his two sons who are following in his footsteps so nicely as they warmly welcome you to their restaurant and check on how things are throughout the evening in the gracious style of their dad!

We had such a wonderful time at Vetro's on Saturday night! The food was incredible (I highly recommend the Lobster Cappucino especially), and every attendant, from valet to hostess to server, was genuinely friendly and attentive. We were seated in kind of a nook next to a window overlooking the water, and it was not only a gorgeous view, but a great noise level to be able to really talk at our table. We could hear the music, but it was not too loud, nor were the other diners. It's not cheap, but it is totally worth it for a special and memorable time together-- we brought relatives from California who we hadn't seen in a long time, and they couldn't stop raving about it.
It's like having lunch at the shore without the trip. It's easily accessible by public transportation.
FOOD WAS OK. SERVICE WAS FANTASTIC. NOT MANY CHOICES OF FOOD THOUGH.
Best Italian Food in Sourther Queens

The parking vallet was in a rush to kick us out because the roof top crowd was coming in which we felt was very rude. Also the front desk person seemed cold and uninviting which is not something a place like Vetro should have as the face of their establishment. Our waiter Joe was a great guy who was professional patient and Accommodating when my friend wanted to order something not on the menu. The Bus boy was very nice and not in any rush to clean off our table. The bread and oil were Amazing!!!! Food was good not the best Italian food but it past and I will come again. I believe their eggplant is not made fresh it seemed as though it may have been frozen before served. Other then just a few kinks Vetro is a Gem.
a lttle noisy but great place to eat

We decided to brave the wind and sit outside for our meal. I can't believe this place is in Queens. Felt like a cross between an upscale NYC restaurant and a spacious Long Island - waterfront property.
This is my second dining experience at Vetro, first was dinner and now lunch yesterday.
PS with the weather getting nicer, the rooftop lounge and outdoor dining area are sure to be a hit!
